store.name: Totally Legit Wheeler Seller
store.short: Run your own shady car lot! Buy cheap, patch it up and flip for profit. Haggle prices, roll back the mileage and become the king of sketchy deals. If you’ve ever dreamed of selling a rust bucket for a grand, this is your moment.
store.about:
Welcome to the world of the ultimate wheeler-dealer, master of quick fixes and king of car lot hustle!
 You run your own used car lot on the edge of nowhere. Buy for pennies, sell for dollars, and let smooth talk and carefully retouched photos seal the deal.

 🎯 Hunt for bargains 
Scour junkyards, talk to shady characters, and hunt for cars with “personality.” Every ride has a story (and probably a few hidden problems).

 🔧 Make it look ‘like new’ 
Putty, hammer, spray paint—done! Looks good… well, from certain angles. Turn wrecks into “miracles of engineering”—or at least make them look great in photos.

 💬 “Who needs AC? Just roll down the window!” 
Haggle like a pro: pick your dialogue lines, slide that price bar, and drop unforgettable one-liners like:
 “Knock off a little and I’ll be back in an hour with my cousin.” 

 📸 Take the Perfect Pic, Edit the Hell Out of It 
Use your magical laptop to turn trash into treasure. A little filter here, a little retouch there... and voila – showroom-ready deception.

 🌍 Your own lot in an open world 
Expand your lot, unlock new features like car washes or miracle tuning shops, and make your mark in the world of Totally Legit Business™.

 🐈 Bonus: The Ginger Cat 
He’s watching. Always. And yes – it’s the same cat every time .

 Totally Legit Wheeler Seller mixes humor, hustling, and a love for sketchy car deals into one wild package. A little sanding, a little spray paint, and boom—it’s good enough to sell.

store.name: Monkeys!¡
store.short: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!
store.about:
A wacky high-tempo visual novel from the creative team behind Marco and the Galaxy Dragon and The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart ! FEATURES
 Single-ending visual novel with 2+ hours of story

 Full Japanese voice acting
 STORY
Saruyoshi, the world’s greatest delinquent, is stomping his way to a prestigious girls’ school under the alias— “Julia.” 

WHY, SARUYOSHI?! OH, WHY WOULD YOU DO THIS?!?!
To save the unprestigious boys’ school he attends!

To preserve the place where he has made friends and memories, Saruyoshi must convince Garasunomiya Girls’ School to go co-ed!
With the help of the bored and wealthy Karasu Tsukishima, he bravely attends Garasunomiya in order to improve the girls’ image of guys!

In his time at Garasunomiya, will Saruyoshi FINALLY figure out girls?!
In their time with Saruyoshi, will the girls of Garasunomiya finally find some measure of redeeming value in guys?!

As Saruyoshi sets his himbo brain to work solving Garasunomiya’s problems, the girls find their hearts growing fonder and fonder!

As Saruyoshi begins to act more like a lady, his friends back home just get more and more confused?!

Guys and girls, living together—a romanti-slapstick comedy ensues!

store.name: Invokyr
store.short: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.
store.about:
Every Roll Summons a New Surprise! 

 You’re trapped. The house groans around you. Cold. Dark. On the table sits a 1970s board game, dusty but humming with energy. You’d heard rumours, of course. About the board, the house. You look to your friends, and a voice, whimsical yet bitter, speaks: “Let’s play a game.” 
 Once a beloved toy, the Gamemaster now rules this abandoned house. Escape is possible but only if you play. You roll the dice, and another worldly sound echoes through the house. Will you win your freedom or be dragged into the darkness?

 Beat the Gamemaster 

 Play the game and survive the unpredictable terrors, traps, and curses that are summoned. Reach the end and you’ll escape. Perhaps.

 Face the Fear Together 

 Online co-op with up to 6 players. Work together… or leave someone behind. Death is not always the end.

 Explore to Find Dice 

 Scour the house to recover the dice hidden within. Each can only be used once. Choose wisely.

 Special Dice 
 Some dice offer powers to heal, hide, or hinder those who hunt you, but nothing comes without risk.

 Try Not to Get Lost 

 The house is a labyrinth of rooms. Lose your way, and you may never make it back to the board.

 Fear-filled Features: 
 Immerse yourself in a co-op psychological horror, built around a cursed game that is desperate to be played.

 Face bizarre, unique creatures: each with their own way of hunting.

 Traps, curses, and chaos await every turn.

 The house has different biomes: jungle, ice mountain, oversized toy chest.

 Survive to earn rewards… and unlock more formidable challenges. Will...

store.name: Westlanders
store.short: Survive a wild-west open world alone or with friends. Travel the land with your wagon, build settlements, fend off foes, and weave a powerful economic network across the wilderness. Forge your legacy in the Westlands.
store.about:
Survive a realistic open world that’s teeming with life and fraught with peril. Venture out with trusted friends in PvE multiplayer. Or go it alone.

 Explore vast landscapes from your customizable wagon, relocating as needed to seek out vital resources, hidden locations, and unique characters.
 Struggle against nature. Frostbite, heatstroke, disease and wild animals are all threats that could end your life.

 Progress through an extensive tech tree based on late 1800s technology. Go from bushcraft and improvised weapons to iron forged tools and firearms.
 Build and customize your own settlements, supply them through farming and mining, and transform the wilderness into bustling hubs.

 Optimize your production lines through research and worker automation. Establish a network of settlements across the entire valley and recruit the NPCs you meet to live there.
 Connect your outposts and settlements with roads and logistic networks to ensure your people thrive. Go beyond survival and forge your legacy in the Westlands.

store.name: Gamble With Your Friends
store.short: An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.
store.about:
Gamble With Your Friends 
 An online 1-6 player co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends share one bank account and one massive debt. Gamble, buy sketchy items, make terrible decisions, and climb an ominous casino tower to hit your loan shark’s daily quota in 5 minutes - or face the consequences.
 FEATURES: 
 🥳 1–6 player online co-op

 ⏰ Around 2-3 hours of playtime with 3 endings

 🃏 17 different games of chance

 🧐 15+ sketchy items to fight the odds

 🏗️ 4 distinctly themed casino floors

 🥸 Many emotes + customization options

 🎙️ Proximity voice chat 

 🎶 Original soundtrack from artists behind tracks featured in HASTE, ROUNDS, Stick Fight, POST VOID, TABS , and more

 SHARING IS CARING 
 It’s not my money, it’s our money. Coordinate with your friends to manage a shared bank account while you gamble your way out of debt… because one bad all-in can ruin the run for everyone.

 WELCOME TO JEFF BOOTH’S PARADISE 
 Each “day,” you get 5 minutes inside the casino to earn as much cash as possible. The tower has 4 distinctly themed floors , each with its own games of chance, randomized every time you enter. Unlock higher floors as you get richer (and bolder).

 TICKETS, TRADES, AND TERRIBLE IDEAS 
 Hit your quota, complete unique challenges, or even sell a body part or two to earn Tickets . Spend Tickets on sketchy items to bend the odds in your team's favor. But even if you do everything “right"... Lady Luck still has the final say .

 LOOK COOL WHILE YOU LOSE 
 Spend Tickets on cosmetics back in the neighborhood. Is it optimal? No. Is it stylish?...

store.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
store.short: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.
store.about:
Dive into a story-driven cozy horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill. A miracle crop designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. It twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, hollowed out by a chemical addiction and driven by primal hunger. Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safe haven. But their journey draws the attention of the Pastor and his mysterious following. He sees remaining humans not as people, but as fertile soil for his plans.

 A FALLEN WORLD 
 Streets lie abandoned, buildings rot from the inside out, and strange vegetation reclaims the earth at an accelerated rate. Traces of the past linger in barricaded homes, ransacked offices with scattered supplies, and stores picked clean of basic goods. In a world shaped by desperation, how far will you go to survive?
 FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE 
 Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution: every door can lead to salvation… or devastation.
 PROTECT WHAT MATTERS MOST 
 Protect Ava at all costs. The world can die, but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a hostile wilderness that wants you gone. No one is coming to save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.
 COZY HORROR AT HEART 
 Experience a new unique blend of tension and comfort. The Road of Dust and Sorrow establishes a new cozy horror...

store.name: When The Sun Dies
store.short: When the Sun Dies is an open-world survival crafting game. Explore a mysterious land, build your base, dig underground, craft weapons, and battle dangerous mutants. Survive deadly storms and uncover the secrets behind a world falling apart — alone or with friends.
store.about:
Something went wrong in Blackpine. 
 An unexplained anomaly has transformed the region. Research teams sent to investigate have vanished, communications have gone silent, and dangerous creatures now roam the land.
 You are sent to uncover what happened.
 But Blackpine is no longer a place where survival can be taken for granted.
 When the Sun Dies is a first-person, open-world survival crafting game where exploration, base building, resource management, and combat come together in a mysterious, hostile world.

 Explore forests, abandoned facilities, underground caves, and mysterious locations scattered across a procedurally generated world.
 Dig into the terrain, mine valuable resources, discover hidden supplies, and follow the traces left behind by missing research teams.
 Every expedition brings new opportunities — and new dangers.

 Gather resources, construct your shelter, and turn it into a fully functioning survival base.
 Build structures and crafting stations.

 Grow crops, cook meals, and manage food supplies.

 Craft weapons, tools, and specialized equipment.

 Repair damaged gear and improve your production.

 Research new technologies and expand your capabilities.

 Your base is more than a shelter. It's the foundation of your survival.

 Hunger, thirst, exhaustion, disease, and dangerous environmental conditions are constant threats.
 But nature isn't your only enemy.
 The Yellow Storm forces you to seek protection while creating opportunities to collect rare resources.
 The Long Night brings extended darkness and relentless enemy attacks, testing everything...

store.name: Land Of The Valiants
store.short: Land of the Valiant blends RPG, survival, and life simulation in a multiplayer medieval world. Build, produce, trade, and survive in a player-driven economy where Khalendor becomes what its inhabitants make of it.
store.about:
Land of the Valiant is a multiplayer medieval fantasy world where survival, economy, and society are shaped by the players who inhabit it.
 Set in the fractured lands of Khalendor , the game blends RPG, survival, and life simulation in a persistent world built around scarcity, cooperation, and player-driven progression.
 Claim land, build a home, grow crops, raise animals, gather resources, craft goods, trade with others, and take part in production chains that form the foundation of a living economy. Food, shelter, weather, and resources matter — survival is part of everyday life.
 But no one truly lives alone.
 Players produce what others need. Farmers feed settlements. Craftsmen transform raw materials into valuable goods. Traders connect distant communities. Guilds organize people, resources, and territory. As the world grows, its economy and society grow with it — driven as much as possible by the actions of its players rather than artificial systems.
 Beyond civilization lies a dangerous fantasy world of exploration, combat, creatures, ancient ruins, and the remnants of a civilization lost during the Age of Shadows .
 There is no single way to live in Khalendor.
 Become a farmer, craftsman, merchant, warrior, explorer, landowner — or simply find your own place in the world.
 Survive. Build. Trade. Cooperate. Compete. 
 Khalendor will become what its players make of it.

store.name: Escape from Tarkov
store.short: Escape from Tarkov is the original extraction FPS where every raid is a gamble with death. Prep your raid, bleed, endure and fight through ruthless PMC players and Scavs, gain tactical advantage and cling to your loot — only extraction decides if you live or lose it all.

store.name: Sally Face 2
store.short: After the haunting climax of Sally Face, the sequel continues the dark adventure with a group of friends struggling to find meaning in a world broken by darkness.
store.about:
THE DARK ADVENTURE CONTINUES
 After the haunting climax of Sally Face, the sequel continues the dark adventure with a group of friends struggling to find meaning in a world broken by darkness. When everything falls apart… When even death holds no solace… What’s left to hold on to?
 FEATURES
 A side-scrolling, narrative-driven adventure game 

 Challenging puzzles (and a hint system for those that need help)

 Inspired by 90s cartoons and personal nightmares

 Hand crafted by humans

store.name: EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27
store.short: Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine.
store.about:
Run the league one decision at a time. EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 27, powered by the all-new Persona Engine, transforms Franchise into a reactive, always-evolving league where every NFL athlete has a distinct, realistic personality that informs their motivations, demands and reactions. Gameplay gets physical with more precise control from authentic WR/DB battles, new short-yardage mechanics, defensive coverage improvements and new strategic pre-play settings and controls. Build your NFL legacy on a deeper progression path in the new Superstar G.O.A.T. Career Journey and control your roster with more customization with Ultimate Team Captains.

 FRANCHISE 

The all-new Persona Engine gives every NFL athlete a distinct personality that informs their motivations, how they think and how they respond, transforming your Franchise into a reactive ever-evolving league shaped by every move you make.

 GAMEPLAY 

Authentic NFL Physicality

Every snap is a battle for control. All-new WR/DB interactions bring true NFL physicality to every route, with realistic hand-fighting, jostling, and leverage that define separation and coverage. Win tight 50-50 moments with timing-based catching and refined contested interactions, or take command in critical situations with improved short-yardage mechanics and plays like the “Tush Push” that decide games when inches matter most.

Gameplanning & Customization

Own every decision before and after the snap. New gameplan adjustments let you preconfigure how your team aligns and reacts, while streamlined pre-play controls put every adjustment at your...

store.name: KingFish
store.short: A 2-player asymmetric co-op game where a King and a giant Fish, a living island, build a city, travel between islands, and defend their kingdom together. One plans from above. The other fights on the ground. Together they stand.
store.about:
The world is a wild ocean, filled with monsters and danger. After a betrayal, a young King awakens an ancient Leviathan - a living island capable of carrying an entire city. Together, they must build a kingdom, travel between islands, and face the horrors rising from the mist. 
 TWO PLAYERS, TWO PLAYSTYLES 
 One player, as the Fish, plays with a strategic view. The Fish controls the city building and supports the King on the battlefield with a wider perspective. The other player, as the King, acts on the ground with a third person isometric view. The King fights enemies, gathers resources, listens to villagers' needs. 
 ASYMMETRIC CO-OP 
 Two players share one goal, but have different roles. The Fish sees the full picture, manages the city layout, production, and incoming threats. The King acts on the ground and sees what the Fish can’t spot, the details: villagers’ needs, nearby dangers, the fight itself. Coordination between the King and the Fish is key. 

 UNIQUE VILLAGERS 
 Every villager in the KingFish is unique, with their own perks, weapons and preferences. The unique abilities of the villagers are a cornerstone of both the kingdom's defense and its economy. Level up and equip your villagers to turn them into powerful warriors or skilled artisans.  

 ROGUELIKE CITY BUILDING 
 Every run brings new maps, new mechanics and new challenges. 
Together you adapt to what you find, and survive as long as you can.

store.name: RV There Yet?
store.short: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.
store.about:
DRIVE HOME 
 You and your buddies are on your way home from a relaxing vacation but are forced to take an alternate route. Get your RV through the back country and find the exit to Route 65.

 SURVIVE MABUTTS VALLEY 
 Not everyone who enters Mabutts Valley makes it out alive. So be sure to keep a steady flow of burgers, antidotes, and the classic: EpiPens.

 WINCH IT GOOD 
 Master the physics based winch and earn the right to be the main remote commander. With a winch front and rear, your RV is especially equipped to get over, under or through most road bumps.

 HELP YOURSELF, AND EACH OTHER 
 Help yourself to cold brewskis and filtered low tar cigarettes, but don’t forget that the driver will have a hard time completing this journey alone. 

 A SCRAPPY BUNCH 
 Use everything you find to maintain the integrity of your RV and friendships.

 Features :
 Drive one RV together with up to 4 players

 Winch

 Proximity Chat

 Online co-op

 Hats

 Grill frozen meat patties

 Smoke Cigarettes

store.name: Cheater's Table
store.short: At this table, cheating is the game. Hide your power cards up your sleeve or down your pant leg, then strike when the time is right. But stay sharp - a scratch isn't always a cheat. This table is full of traps...
store.about:
CONTENT NOTE: 
 This game contains NO gambling, alcohol, profanity or sexual content. Just milk.
 PLAY FAIR. DIE FIRST. 
 Cheater’s Table is a 2–4 player online card game of cheating and bluffing.
 Empty your hand. Cheat. Catch cheaters. Don’t fall for traps. Control the table and stay alive.
 HIDE YOUR CARD 
 Want to play a card that doesn’t match the table?
 Hide it in your sleeve or pant leg. Pull it out and play it when the time is right.
 If someone challenges you and finds it, you pay the price.
 If they fail, they do.

 DON’T TAKE THE BAIT
 But not every suspicious move is a cheat.
 Challenge someone and you might walk straight into their trap. Ignore it, and the trap backfires on the player who set it.
 PICK YOUR PUNISHMENT
 Cards, dynamites, or a Cadillac... What kind of trap do you want to set?
 The host decides what kind of chaos takes over the table. Every punishment carries its own risk, and one wrong decision can completely change the course of the match.
 PLAY THE MILK. END THE MATCH.
 Milk is your final card. Play it to win the match instantly.
 If nobody manages to play Milk, the last player alive wins.

 SET UP YOUR OWN TABLE
 Choose total chaos with cheats, traps, and deadly punishments. Change the rules in Lab Mode and shape the game your way.
 Want a calmer table? Choose Old School and remove cheating entirely.
 Set the rules. Pick your punishment. Invite your friends. Trust no one.

 FEATURES
 2–4 player online matches

 Cheat and cheat-catching system

 High-risk trap mechanics

 Card, Cadillac, and dynamite punishments

 Instant victory with Milk

...

store.name: The Hero is too Powerful so let's Pleeeease Settle this Peacefully!
store.short: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!
store.about:
The proble- er- story so far...
 Haryun is the son of the venerated hero Harold which is a bit of a problem since Harold was also the one who taught him the sword. Why would learning the sword from a hero be a problem? Because, he was so powerful  that the kingdom forced him into retirement!!!
 So, now he needs to save his childhood friend (from some illness or something; it's probably not too serious anyway). On his journey Haryun will (peacefully?) solve many problems and work together with an incredibly powerful witch!
 (Player plays the game here.)
 The end.
 (Anti-)Features
 Attack: You can make a super-duper extra over-powered attack which will make you level up and only increase the damage further! (The attack preparations shorten as your level increases.)

 Talk: Let's pleeease  settle this peacefully!

 Look:  I promise this isn't just a slightly different thing from Talk ... I mean you use your eyes.

 Forgiving difficulty: Maps reset because they're probably never more than a little damaged.

 Unforgiving difficulty: Attacked the wrong person? Too bad you'll never know. Just give up and ask for some forgiveness (the only forgiving option is to change the difficulty).

 More:  There's a menu, the game saves, and all kinds of other things you normally find in games!

store.name: Project Shadowglass
store.short: A stealth-focused immersive sim set within a dark fantasy kingdom. Plan daring heists, infiltrate forbidden locales, and escape with priceless artifacts. Features revolutionary 3D pixel art graphics and lasting consequences where every action could leave a trail back to you.
store.about:
Project Shadowglass is a love letter to classic immersive FPS stealth sims such as Thief, Deus Ex, and System Shock, built with unique 3D pixel art technology.
 You play a struggling thief, mysteriously tasked by an anonymous source to "acquire" ancient artifacts hidden across the realm. To succeed, you will need to rely on your wits and tools of the trade to pull off seemingly impossible heists.
 By day, you will plan and prepare from your humble flat in the slums. Spend the gold you've acquired on new tools and items, upgrade your hidden workshop, acquire intel, and case your next target location.
 By night, you must move and act unseen if you wish to succeed. You are no warrior. You're alone, vulnerable, outmatched, and outnumbered. Every person has a name, and a memory. One false misstep could mean fleeing for your life, hiding for days, or engaging in terrifying melee combat that leaves marks remembered by all.
 Gameplay: 
 - Navigate using light and sound: hide in the darkness, study patrol routes, and choose quiet surfaces over loud ones
 - Manipulate the environment: douse torches, create distractions, use surroundings to your advantage
 - Infiltrate secure areas: pick locks, pickpocket keys, and climb to forbidden places to gain the upper hand
 - Deal with threats: knock out guards, hide bodies and evidence, or risk deadly blade-to-blade combat
 - Complete the heist: gain access, steal treasures, and escape
 Features: 
 - Multiple approaches and solutions with a sandbox design philosophy
 - Unique rendering technology creates nostalgic pixel art in full 3D space
...

store.name: Dark Craft
store.short: Dark Craft is the first MMORPG in the Souls-like genre! Explore an open world filled with ruined castles, forgotten temples, and enemies waiting for their prey. Play solo or with friends, hunt bosses, join guilds, fight other players, and prove your right to reign supreme.
store.about:
Dark Craft is a free-to-play MMO set in a grim dark-fantasy world, where a vast open world and a Souls-style combat system turn every encounter into a true challenge. The world is filled with secrets and dangers: monsters are ruthless, and other players can become either allies or enemies. Explore the lands, discover rare artifacts, and fight alone or with a group — in Dark Craft, your path is defined by your choices and your ability to endure in a harsh world.

 A World Shaped by Game Masters
 The world of Dark Craft lives independently: enemies patrol territories, locations breathe dark-fantasy atmosphere, and events unfold regardless of player actions. But above all this operates a unique layer — a system controlled by our game masters, members of the team who can directly intervene in gameplay. They can command enemies and set up unexpected ambushes, appear in the form of world bosses, issue unique quests, or trigger events that will never happen again. This creates the feeling of a truly living world, where every adventure is unpredictable and one-of-a-kind.

 Gameplay
 Each venture into the world is a true trial for the player. Expect grim locations filled with deadly enemies, hidden dangers, and other hunters chasing after artifacts. Combat is built around timing, stamina management, and the ability to predict your opponent’s moves.
 Every encounter carries risk: victory brings loot, while defeat takes part of it away.
 A Living World
 Explore forests, abandoned villages, ancient castles, and dungeons. At every step you may encounter enemies or stumble upon the...

store.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
store.short: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

store.name: Parasite Mutant
store.short: This is a bio-horror RPG featuring a retro third-person semi-fixed camera and an ATC combat system that blends real-time and turn-based elements. You play as Nova, a Psionic Agent sent to investigate a mysterious abandoned city-island, ultimately uncovering the hidden truth and rewriting fate.
store.about:
Parasite Mutant is a sci-fi horror RPG set in the distant future. Psionic agent Nova was sent on a mission to an abandoned and secluded island city filled with horrifying creatures, not knowing that what happened on the island will completely change her fate. Combat System
Parasite Mutant uses ATC (Active Time Chains) which combines the popular Active Time Battle system used in RPGs of the late-90s and a 3-segment chain system. Players will need to time their actions on each segments and decide whether they want to save their energy and do a chain release.[/p] As the gauge fills up, players will need to dodge enemy attacks and launch their attack at the best possible time.
 We hope that this little innovation of ours will bring an enjoyable and pleasant gameplay experience to our players.

 Art Style
Parasite Mutant uses a semi-realistic anime art style and utilizes modern rendering techniques to give our players a HD visual experience. Additionally, we have introduced a retro filter and CRT filter to bring players back that late-90s to 2000s vibe.

 Setting
Parasite Mutant is a survival horror game with a diverse array of horrifying mutants. In the game, players will solve various puzzles in search of answers and maybe uncover the horrifying secret of this universe.
 Level Up System
Parasite Mutant uses the classic equipment progression system. Players can attach various modules onto their equipment, or enhance their equipment using Plus Points that can be obtained through combat. New Game+
Parasite Mutant has a New Game+ mode that allows players to inherit Plus Points...

store.name: Froggin' Around
store.short: Froggin Around is a two player local co-op game where you play as two mischievous frogs on a magical quest! Use your stretchy, bouncy tongues to swing, grab objects, and help each other hop through puzzles and chaotic challenges in this light-hearted, physics-based co-op adventure!
store.about:
Froggin' Around is a  FROG-TABULOUS,  two player, co-op only experience.  🐸 
 Play as two FROGS  on a magical quest.✨
 Work together and use your FROG POWERS  to progress and solve puzzles through this colorful fantasy world.
 Embody a frog 🐸 
 Crawl around, stretch your tongue, croak and eat flies

 Cooperate 🤝 
 Collaborate with your partner to solve clever puzzles

 Explore a magical world 🔮 
 From the wizard's workshop to the glowing sewers, travel through a variety of unusual locations
 Find bouncy mushrooms, flying books and other intriguing objects on your path

store.name: Arctic Drive
store.short: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.
store.about:
Pile your friends into a rusted pickup and drive into a frozen wasteland that wants you dead. 
 Arctic Drive (or Artic Drive for some) is a first-person co-op survival sim for 1–4 players, where your car is your shelter, your storage and your only way out. Scavenge, craft, repair, and keep the engine alive one more mile.
 Just don't let anyone near the handbrake. 

 Your car is your shelter, your storage and your only way forward. Keep it fuelled, keep it in one piece and keep it on the road of the arctic (artic) .
 Damage is fully simulated: the chassis bends, parts break off, and one bad corner on the ice can end the whole trip.  The cold kills you slowly. The icy road kills your car fast. 

 Every item in the world is a real physical object.  If you can lift it, you can load it.  Jerrycans in the trunk, boxes across the back seat, a trailer packed to the brim behind you.
 But weight burns fuel faster, and one tight turn can spread the whole haul across the snow.

 Nothing out here is junk. Empty boxes, broken parts, scrap metal: recycle it into materials, then craft the upgrades and spare parts that keep you rolling.
 Find a working generator with a recycler and crafting bench, and you've found a reason to stop for the night. Hook up a trailer or an RV and turn it into a base on wheels.

 Every run generates a new road. Around the next bend there might be a cabin, a gas station with fuel left lying around in jerry cans, or nothing but shelter from a blizzard.
 Whiteouts swallow the road, night falls hard, and you're managing hunger, thirst and body temperature the whole...

store.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
store.short: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.
store.about:
◆ Story
 “When Failed Creations with the same name meet, they have to kill each other.”
 This is the Remnant World, a place where Failed Creations from abandoned stories are gathered.
 Failed Creations who share the same name must kill one another, and only the last one left alive can become the “real” one.
 In this world governed by that cruel rule, an amnesiac Sensei awakens.
 There, Sensei encounters three Alices, each a Failed Creation of Alice in Wonderland.
 The three of them are likewise destined to kill one another in order to become the “real” Alice.
 However, their encounter with Sensei sends that destiny wildly off course.
 This is a retold tale of three Alices and an amnesiac Sensei setting out on a journey together...

 ■ Characters 
 ・Prima, the red Alice
 VA: Aoi Yuki
 A Failed Creation of Alice.
 Clad in a red dress and armed with a single blade, she acts on impulse and instinct.
 Reckless and prone to acting before she speaks, she nevertheless cares deeply for her companions. Her trust in and attachment to Sensei are especially strong.
 Though she occasionally displays a dangerously possessive side, a little praise is all it takes to cheer her up. She is a pure-hearted and straightforward Alice.

 ・Secunda, the Alice with the bow
 VA: Chiwa Saito
 A Failed Creation of Alice.
 A calm and collected archer who excels at ranged attacks, reconnaissance, and assassination.
 Though sharp-tongued and aloof, she is attentive to the needs of others. She recognizes Sensei’s abilities as a strategist and offers her cooperation.
 She is not very good at hiding her...

store.name: Lord of Undead
store.short: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.
store.about:
You are the spirit of an ancient dark sorcerer, banished from the mortal realm centuries ago. But now, these fools have dared to summon you back. Assemble your army of death - the time for vengeance has come!
 SUMMON THE UNDEAD
 You have been granted power over the dead, for you are the Lord of the Undead .
 Create various types of minions: from simple skeletons and zombies to wraiths and plague creatures.
 Craft weapons and armor for them, level them up, and strengthen your army.
 Your minions can carry out various orders. They can be tasked with gathering resources or defending your base. Or, you can command them to raze a human village to the ground…

 RECLAIM YOUR POWER
 Restore your former strength by consuming mortal souls, crafting equipment from found resources, and learning new talents.
 Choose your path of progression: dark magic, archery, heavy weapons and armor - or combine them all.
 Customize your character to fit your playstyle and use a rich set of abilities to leave those pathetic mortals no chance at all.
 BUILD YOUR DARK BASE
 A flexible building system and a variety of structures and workbenches are at your disposal.
 But before you build - desecrate the land! 
 Place Pylons of Darkness in strategic locations and reshape the landscape to suit a dark lord.
 On desecrated ground, you and your minions grow stronger, buildings can regenerate, and resources produce dark essence.

 ANNIHILATE THE MORTALS
 Wipe out entire human settlements, establish your outposts there, and claim their resources.
 Create an invincible army of death and lead it through the...

store.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together
store.short: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. Play solo or with friends (1 to 4 players), with crossplay.
store.about:
Dig deep into the sand, sell what you find, upgrade your equipment and keep digging further and further together (1 to 4 players). Somewhere beneath the beach, a promised treasure is waiting for you.
 With A Game About Digging a Hole Together , we wanted to keep the minimalist formula of the first game and focus on what many of you asked for: more time to dig and the ability to dig together even in crossplay multiplayer .
 It is still about digging, finding resources, upgrading your equipment and seeing what is waiting below. But this time, you don't have to dig by yourself. Though of course, you still can if, like us, you don't have any friends 😭.
 Costs less than a 🍵 matcha latte, lasts longer and is way more fun with friends.

store.name: Dressmaker
store.short: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.
store.about:
Choose fabric, arrange and cut out patterns, sew garments and add decorations. Dressmaker is a cozy simulation game where every part of making a dress is under your control.

 Whether your pattern is aligned to the grain or cut on bias, how you choose to arrange and cut out your fabric is what appears on the final dress. Take full control over what fabric to use for each panel of your garment.

 Feed your fabric through the sewing machine to stitch it together.

 Decorate your dress with buttons, bows and appliqué. Add lace trims and other accessories wherever you like with complete creative freedom.

 Meet a whole town of people hoping to fill their wardrobes with custom-made dresses tailored specially to important events and their individual tastes. Create dresses to impress them, or display your own designs in your shop window and sell pre-made dresses off of the rack.

 Buy from a wide range of fabrics, including cotton, linen, wool, silk and velvet.

 Design and colour your dress in your sketchbook, adding fabric samples and appliqué.

 Arrange and cut out your dress pattern, preview them on a mannequin and sew them together.

 Turn in your dresses to your customers to gain both reputation and coin.

 Pet the kitty.

store.name: Pop Corner
store.short: A relaxing match-3 that floats in a corner of your screen with a transparent background. Match coffee mugs, folders and sticky notes while you work, without leaving what you're doing.
store.about:
--- About this game / Acerca de este juego ---
 Pop Corner is a match-3 game made for quick, low-focus play. It lives in a small, borderless window with a transparent background that always floats above your other apps. Make a move while a file loads, between emails, or while you wait for a meeting.
 [h2]An office to match[/h2]
 Match three or more coffee mugs, folders, sticky notes, plants, envelopes or clocks. Four in a row make a [b]Sweep[/b], an L or T shape makes a [b]Turbo[/b], and five in a row make a [b]Laptop[/b] that clears a whole color. Combine specials for even bigger effects.
 [h2]Made to play while you work[/h2]
 [list]
 [*]Transparent background: choose how much of the board you see, from a glass panel to just the pieces floating over your desktop.
 [*]Always on top, in the corner you choose, in three sizes.
 [*]Fades out when your cursor is away and barely uses any resources.
 [*]Clicks outside the board go through to your apps.
 [*]Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + J hides it instantly.
 [/list]
 [h2]Endless levels[/h2]
 Each level is cleared by scoring 100 points. From level 5, office obstacles appear: boxes, tape, paperwork stacks and filing cabinets, each broken in its own way. Travel through 30 settings, from the Head Office to the Observatory, or unwind in [b]Zen mode[/b], which never ends.
 [h2]Free to play[/h2]
 You get 50 moves every hour, up to a storage of 60. If you want to keep playing, you can buy extra moves or expand your storage.
 [h2]Features[/h2]
 [list]
 [*]Relaxing match-3 with no time pressure
 [*]Floating, transparent window to play while you work

store.name: Palworld: Palfarm
store.short: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!
store.about:
Begin a brand-new cosy life in the world of Palworld!
Together with the mysterious creatures known as Pals that you meet on the Palpagos Islands, build the farm of your dreams in Palfarm!

Move to an island where Pals live and have them help with farm work, cook alongside them, shop at stores they run, or gather materials to expand your farm.
Show your gratitude to the Pals who help you each day by giving them gifts.

On this island with its changing seasons, a relaxing farm life with Pals awaits!
Of course, eating your own Pals is absolutely out of the question!
In Palfarm, Pals and people live together peacefully in harmony!!

 Farming 
Even barren land can be transformed into a bountiful farm if you work hard together with your Pals.
Each Pal makes use of its special abilities to support to help support your farm!
Pals skilled at sowing will plant seeds, those good at watering will water the crops each day, and Pals skilled with their hands will help harvest crops or assist with crafting.
…Is one of your Pals slacking off? Time to teach them the joy of working.

 Island Life 
The island is home to many unique Pals and residents.
Through daily conversations, working together, or giving gifts from time to time, you can gradually deepen your relationships with both the Pals and the people of the island.
Perhaps the Pals themselves might even play matchmaker with someone you're interested in.
It's even possible for your bond with a Pal or resident to grow into a special relationship…

 Combat 
On the island, nasty Pals that raid farms and ferocious Pals lurking underground...

store.name: EA SPORTS™ College Football 27
store.short: Step into the modern era of college football, where personal ambition meets program pride. Balance expectations, identity, and everything Saturday demands while immersed in traditions and pageantry of game day.
store.about:
In EA SPORTS™ College Football 27, step into the modern era of college football where personal ambition meets program pride. Engineer your program with Dynasty Blueprint, build your player and take on new positions in Road to Glory, and play as your favorite mascots in Mascot Mashup while immersed in the iconic traditions and pageantry of game day.

 DYNASTY 

All-new Dynasty Blueprint puts you in control of your program’s future. Navigate Athletic Director Expectations and use Dynasty Points for recruiting, NIL, staff, and facilities to build your College Football powerhouse.

 ROAD TO GLORY 

Define your path in Road to Glory, and experience new customization options and positions as you build your player. Earn NIL deals, chase the Heisman, develop your Draft Stock, and raise your Legacy Score with each decision you make.

 MASCOT MASHUP 

Play as your favorite mascot in Mascot Mashup. Collect over 120 larger-than-life icons, and bring the chaos to wild 11-on-11 matchups packed with over-the-top celebrations and mascot antics fueled by pure school spirit.

 STORYTELLING & PRESENTATION 

Feel every moment of game day, and experience college football at its height. Dynamic weather, expanded pageantry, and a new broadcast package delivers deeper immersion as dynamic storytelling connects your journey to the sights, sounds, and stakes of Saturday.

 GAMEPLAY 

Turn every touch into a highlight. Feel the difference of standout athletes impacting every play, from smarter route running and coverage to explosive WR vs. DB battles, while more streamlined, customizable pre-play...

store.name: Exterminauts
store.short: Exterminauts is a co-op third-person PvE shooter using weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets to exterminate alien pests. Take on MegaCorp contracts amid energy supremacy clashes, while aliens' thirst for Polymorphic Plasma disrupts plans. Punch In. Clean Up. Get Paid.
store.about:
3-PLAYER BLUE-COLLAR CREW 
 Forget the righteous battle cries of heroes. Here, combat is stripped down to a professional routine. Form a tight-knit trio of gritty, down-to-earth Exterminauts dealing with corporate honey traps and blood-soaked pest control. Every work order costs company money , so cover your crewmates, tally up your expenses, and survive your shift together.

 WEAPONIZED POWER TOOLS 
 Industrial-grade gunplay where your everyday tools are your firearms. Unleash a flood of firepower with heavy-duty utility and repair equipment repurposed for slaughter. Activate the multi-purpose OVERDRIVE system to turn typical blue-collar gear into devastating, alien-shredding weapons.

 A HOSTILE ALIEN ECOSYSTEM 
 TIAN is a living world that fights back. You aren't just shooting bugs in an unchanging arena; you're invading a living, breathing ecosystem. With the alien threat always adapting to your squad's tactics, your 3-player team is forced to constantly communicate, reposition, and change strategies to survive this chaotic slugfest.

store.name: Drawquarium
store.short: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.
store.about:
Hi, I'm Kaleb! I work as a 3D artist in the film industry, but my heart kept pulling me toward a small, very personal game idea. One of the reasons I started developing this game was that I wanted to bring my children’s drawings to life 💖. 

 Drawquarium is a relaxing aquarium sandbox where your drawings come to life! Draw your own fish and plants, feed them, raise them, and collect golden fish scales to unlock new decorations and tools. Create your own cozy little underwater world and bring it to your desktop as an animated wallpaper!

 And don't worry, you don't have to be an artist to create something beautiful! You can always choose from a variety of ready-made fish and simply enjoy watching your little aquarium come to life. 

 Draw Your Own Fish COMPANIONS 
 Draw anything you want and watch your creations come to life inside your aquarium. Start with simple shapes, use templates for a little inspiration, or get as creative as you like. There are no rules, just you and your imagination!

 When you place new creatures in your fish tank, they will interact with the others, forming friendships, rivalries and even relationships. They can become enemies and quibble or find their soulmate and have cute little babies 🥰.

 Decorate With Your Own Plants 
 Any decent aquarium will need an abundance of thriving plants. Create the perfect habitat by drawing your own vegetation and placing it wherever you want. Of course, if you’d rather be drawing sea mines or skyscrapers… Who are we to stop you?

 Wallpaper mode!
 Miss your babies whenever you go and close the game? Simply...

store.name: Squadron 42
store.short: Enlist in the UEE Navy in a cinematic, single-player space adventure. Pilot combat ships, fight on foot, and explore capital ships, space stations, and frontier outposts. Live and work alongside your crew as you battle on the front lines of a galactic war.
store.about: Enlist as a rookie in the UEE Navy and step into a cinematic, single-player space adventure where you are at the center of the action. Live, work, and fight alongside your crew, brought to life by an all-star cast, as the story unfolds across fighter cockpits, capital ships, space stations, frontier outposts, and the front lines of a galactic war. Through intense combat, sacrifice, and the choices you make when it matters most, you will earn your place, your rank, and your legacy. You don’t watch the rise of a hero. You become one.

store.name: SlashZero
store.short: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?
store.about:
SlashZero is a 3D anime-style side-scrolling action roguelike game. In this game, you can unleash flashy moves, dive into thrilling combat and customize endless builds to suit your playstyle. Fight, power up, collect items and uncover the hidden truth beneath this stunning cyberpunk world!

 Master rich movesets and in-depth combat combos featuring signature aerial strings. Dash, vault, and fight across multi-layered maps for smooth, parkour-style action!

 Feel every strike with precise hit feedback. Diverse level designs keep every battle fresh and challenging. Dominate foes by blending acrobatic finesse with tactical combat strategy to claim victory!

 Try out different Timehackers and find the combat playstyle that suits you best. Are you a melee expert? A ranged specialist? Or do you prefer something more flexible in both offense and defense? Find your style as you experience each character's unique movesets and explore their stories!

 Mix and match a wide range of in-run and out-of-run systems to shape your own combat build. In every run, you can choose a path and grow stronger as you follow it. Combine the power of Blessings from different Authorities, harness the run-changing effects of Temporal Fragments, and equip Upgrade Chips that can fundamentally reshape how your character plays. Back at the base, unlock permanent progression options to prepare for what comes next. Increase your stats, acquire Dual Blessings, gain additional rerolls, and more! You may even get to bring your own preset builds into future runs!

 As the timelines collapse, HIEROS-I descends,...

store.name: Trust Your Gut
store.short: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.
store.about:
TRUST YOUR GUT is a multi-ball roulette rogue-lite. Stack mementos and balls, place your bets, spin the wheel, and survive one more day. 

 Inspired by Clover Pit, Balatro, and Buckshot Roulette, combine Mementos with unique Ball abilities to create powerful synergies and builds. Pay off your debt, make it to the end of the show, and when you've finally earned your freedom, can you stop?

 Features: 

 Multi-ball roulette with powerful synergies and builds.

 100+ Mementos and 50+ Ball variants. 

 Offers that change the rules. 

 Countless ways to manipulate the odds. 

 4 playable characters with different playstyles. 

 Showdowns that throw your run into chaos. 

 Campaign and Endless modes. 

 Leaderboards to push your score higher.

 For those who believe bad luck ruined their lives, the show offers a second chance. Step into a deadly game of roulette, pay off your debt, and earn the life you think you were denied.  Everyone has someone to blame. Not here.

store.name: PUBG: Black Budget
store.short: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.
store.about:
※ This footage is from a version still in development and may differ from the actual game. 

 About PUBG: Black Budget   
 Designed as an FPP-first experience, PUBG: Black Budget is a tactical extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown.
 You are a Contractor, a hardened veteran hired for a classified operation on an island at the edge of the world. Your mission is to recover top-secret technology from an abandoned research facility. But there’s a catch: the island is trapped in a time loop, consumed by a supernatural phenomenon known as the Anomaly. Extract artifacts, research your findings, and uncover the truth behind the black-budget initiative, SAPIENS.
 In between missions, you’ll expand your personal Base, craft new equipment, and improve your character’s skills and proficiencies. Prepare to face PvPvE threats in an environment that grows more unpredictable with every loop – and the longer you stay, the harder it is to make it out alive.

 Key Features    
 2.5 × 2.5 km open-world island featuring varied biomes, points of interest, and underground facilities

 Up to 30-minute sessions combining exploration, combat, and extraction

 Persistent inventory: keep what you extract, lose what you bring if you die

 Level- and squad-based matchmaking for up to 3-player squads and 45 players per session

 Dynamic PvPvE encounters against other Contractors and various hostile entities

 The Anomaly gradually shrinks the playable area, creating tense and unpredictable scenarios every loop

 Difficulty scaling that increases with player level and time...

store.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™
store.short: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.
store.about:
​​​​​Star Wars ​​: Galactic Racer™ is a ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​ Star Wars​​ ™​​ galaxy.​​​​

 The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground.  

 Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. 

 No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise.  

 Slam, shunt, and takedown rivals across varied circuits as you pilot landspeeders, speeder bikes, skim speeders, and podracers. The greater the risk, the greater the reward.

 Join the Galactic League - an unsanctioned racing circuit born in the lawless Outer Rim. Become Shade, a lone racer chasing revenge and glory. 

 Pilot different classes of repulsorcraft each with distinct physics and playstyles. Build a ride that showcases your style and gives you a competitive edge.  

 Ride solo through a story-driven campaign of shifting alliances or brave strategic PvP grudge matches where reputation rides with you. 

 Prove yourself through intense rivalries and escalating challenges. Every choice shapes your prospects as you build your status in the Galactic League .

store.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

Embark on a bold reimagining of the acclaimed platformer, filled with new content and narrative twists.
