store.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
store.short: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.
store.about:
Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
 Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.
 Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

 Satisfying Whip Action
 Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
 Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
 Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

 Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
 Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
 Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions.

 Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
 Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
 Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

 Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
 From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
 Explore maps filled with...

store.name: Arcade Warlord
store.short: A business strategy tycoon set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, command a workforce of specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and outmuscle rival companies on the charts or in the streets.
store.about:
You start as the owner of a games studio
 Build a small games studio during the 1980s Arcade Boom. 
Create hit titles, expand across the city, secure valuable businesses and outmaneuver rival companies competing for the same opportunities.
 Run your operation on a tactical map
 In Arcade Warlord , strategy starts with movement.
 Your people have to travel. Your cabinets have to be delivered. Your profits have to be collected. Every new venue adds opportunity, but also distance, travel time and pressure on your fleet.
 Spread across the city to claim more territory and strategic resources, or invest capital to expand vertically and concentrate more cabinets in fewer venues. A wider network increases reach. A denser one reduces travel and lets your company respond faster.

 Hire the right agents for your playing style
 Sales Reps secure new venues. Haulers  move cabinets and resources. Technicians  repair machines and install upgrades. Bagmen collect profits. Enforcers protect key interests or assault competitors.
 Too few Technicians and breakdowns pile up. Too few Haulers and production outruns logistics. Too few Bagmen and money stays trapped in the field. Every role competes for your attention and capacity.
 But do you really need all these? Why not get a couple of Enforcers and extort your rivals? Or simply get a Lead Designer and only release games. 

 Control the streets
 Different venues and businesses provide different advantages: income, Street Influence, Components, Business Intelligence, infrastructure and strategic leverage. Some locations strengthen your...

store.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
store.short: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.
store.about:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer. 

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

The visuals throughout the game have been remastered from the ground up to enhance the cinematic experience of the original. Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered also features gameplay updates, as well as an improved unlock system, so you can unlock monsters, locations, and gallery items in any order you choose. FEATURES 
 The original 2002 Godzilla arena fighter, remastered. 

 12 Kaiju to choose from, each with a uniquely vicious moveset.

 8 locations, including recreated real-world cities, Monster Island, and the Alien Mothership.

 Gallery items to unlock. 

 Play with friends in local co-op and...

store.name: Scars of Honor
store.short: Scars of Honor is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG where player choice, skill-based combat, and meaningful progression shape your legend.
store.about:
Set on the war-torn continent of Aragon, two alliances - the disciplined Sacred Order and the relentless Domination - battle for survival as an ancient Ice Dragon stirs in the frozen North.
 Choose your faction, race, and class, then build your hero through a modern MMO combat system, evolving talents, personal Scars, meaningful crafting, and endlessly replayable Evershifting Dungeons.
 KEY FEATURES:

 Fast, modern MMO combat that rewards positioning, timing, and decision-making. Master active abilities, react to enemy patterns, and outplay your opponents rather than relying on rotations alone.

 Shape your character with over 240 talents per class and permanent Scars that fundamentally alter your abilities and playstyle. Every choice matters, creating builds that feel personal, powerful, and distinct.

 No two dungeon runs are the same. Dynamic layouts, shifting encounters, and changing modifiers ensure each run offers new challenges, strategies, and rewards.

 Choose from unique races and unconventional classes, each grounded in the world’s lore and identity. Visual design, abilities, and narrative themes reinforce meaningful faction and character choice.

 Test your skill in Arenas and 5v5 Battlegrounds with equalized gear. Victory is determined by teamwork, strategy, and mastery.

 Craft, upgrade, and customize gear to complement your build and preferred playstyle. Progression supports experimentation, letting you refine your character as you grow stronger.

 A fair monetization model focused on cosmetics and convenience only. Power is earned through gameplay, not...

store.name: Reshine
store.short: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.
store.about:
Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.
 Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.

 Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

 The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

 When every part looks like new, you can slowly bring everything back together. Piece by piece, watch the object take shape again. Before you know it, it’s looking like its old self again, or maybe even better.

 And that's it! Compare your final result with the object before restoration to see how much it has changed. You can repeat the restoration as many times as you want, to try different colors or just relive the experience. But, most importantly, more old treasures await you!

store.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
store.short: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.
store.about:
An action RPG for the ages re-emerges better than ever, combining Muramasa Rebirth and the add-on Genroku Legends for the first time. Step into a stunning 4K world steeped in Japanese myth and culture, and take up your blade for refined 2D action and an elevated Muramasa experience filled with new features, including all-new localization and English voiceover.
 New and returning players alike are sure to find a fresh, exhilarating experience awaiting them.

 Deep in the Genroku period of Japan's past, six protagonists fight through a land teeming with wickedness in the hopes of seizing control of their fates once and for all.
 From one who is possessed by the cursed sword Muramasa, to another who swears to avenge their master, and one who pursues love with unwavering passion, each unique story stands on its own. Discover these six distinct tales in any order you choose as they unfold across a beautiful world steeped in the supernatural.

 Cut down the malevolent spirits and dastardly villains that block your path. Chain normal attacks together to naturally unleash combos, then mix in dashes and jumps for even more exhilarating combat as you move fluidly across the ground and the air. Parry and even deflect attacks in the thick of battle. 
 Muramasa’s controls are easy to grasp, yet offer plenty of depth, giving everyone an opportunity to perform spectacular sword-fighting moves.

 Unleash powerful single strikes, wide-area attacks, and ranged attacks, all with a single button press. Combine them with normal attacks to overwhelm your enemies with relentless combos.

 Forge...

store.name: No Mercy
store.short: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.
store.about:
A brutal Bodycam-style first-person shooter about a man forced to return to the violence he swore to leave behind. 
 A powerful criminal faction launches a full-scale coup. Within hours, the city descends into chaos. Police vanish. Communications go dark. Entire districts fall under the control of heavily armed gangs.
 And on the very day the city falls, they take his wife.
 Years ago, he swore never to carry a weapon again. No more bloodshed. No more war.
 But some promises only last until someone takes away the person you love most.
 Now, armed once again, he must fight through gang-controlled streets and fortified strongholds to find his wife and uncover who took her.
 This is not a war for the city.
 This is his war for her. 
 BRUTAL BODYCAM FIREFIGHTS 
 Feel every shot, every impact, and every second of chaos through a raw, immersive bodycam perspective.

 CHOOSE YOUR APPROACH 
 Not every situation should be approached with a direct assault.
 Move quietly, observe enemy movements, use the environment, and choose the right moment to strike. Slip past enemies unnoticed, eliminate them one by one, or engage them in open combat.
 Every district hides another clue. Every answer brings him closer to his wife—and deeper into the conspiracy behind the city’s collapse.

 A CITY BREAKING AROUND YOU 
 Fight through abandoned streets, residential buildings, dark interiors, and fortified gang hideouts.
 Bullets tear through glass, sending shards across the room as seemingly quiet spaces turn into deadly battlefields within seconds. Every shot carries weight, and every firefight...

store.name: We Are So Cooked
store.short: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
store.about:
IT WAS AN ACCIDENT. PROBABLY. 
 DEAD WEIGHT 

 A dead body is heavy, floppy, and incredibly awkward.
 Solo Struggle: Dragging the body alone is slow and leaves a bloody trail.

 Team Lift: Grab a limb each to move faster, but coordinate carefully—if you pull left and your friend pulls right, you’re going to drop him down the stairs.

 Physics Chaos: The body snags on doorframes, knocks over vases, and slides off laundry carts. Every step is a potential disaster.

 THREATS 

 The world is watching.
 Civilians: If a guest sees the body, they scream. Screams attract Guards.

 Security: They hunt noise. If they catch you with the body, it’s over.

 Eyes & Noses: Security Cameras watch the hallways, while Guard Dogs can sniff out the body even if it's hidden inside a locker.

 IMPROVISE YOUR ESCAPE 

 You have no weapons. You have no plan. You only have what you can find.
 Scavenge: Turn the environment into your toolkit. Find a Wheelchair to roll the body past reception. Use a Mop to clean up blood trails. Throw a Squeaky Toy to distract a guard.

 One Hand Only: You can hold an item, OR you can drag the body. You can’t do both. You’ll have to scream at your friends to open doors for you.

 UNIQUE SCENARIOS 

 You aren't just hiding in one building. Every environment forces your team to adapt to new physics hazards and AI threats.
 Crowded Public Spaces: Sneak through luxury hotel lobbies and balance the dead weight on top-heavy luggage carts. Just panic quietly when a nosy maid accidentally rolls away the laundry bin you used as a hiding spot.

 High-Security Compounds:...

store.name: Arctic Grave
store.short: Uncover the mystery of an arctic cargo outpost's lost crew in this horror game. Take in the frozen sea and delve into the depths of the facility, finding items and uncovering new paths with each one to learn what really happened here. But be careful, because something else might be here with you.
store.about:
Uncover the mystery of an arctic cargo outpost's lost crew in this horror game. Take in the frozen sea and delve into the depths of the facility, finding items and uncovering new paths with each one to learn what really happened here. But be careful, because something else might be here with you. 
 Overview
 Arctic Grave  is a short horror game that doesn't rely on jumpscares and focuses instead on level design and building a heavy, sometimes melancholic atmosphere. It doesn't feature combat or resource management and prioritizes exploration, atmosphere and story.
 Explore a cargo outpost in the far north

 One of many, this facility is property of AxiTrans - the largest cargo corporation in the world. Embedded into a cliff and located on a remote shore, it is rarely used yet still houses a small crew.
 However, communication with them was recently lost and nobody knows why.
 Discover what happened to the crew

 As a staff investigator of AxiTrans, you are no stranger to weird occurences across the corporation's many branches. Your usual job is to put together a report about each crew member based on your findings - no matter the situation.
 Delve deep into the facility

 However, something about this particular case quickly proves to be special. The outpost is damaged in bizarre ways and you can't shake the feeling that there is something else here with you. Sabotaging you? It seems like one must descend deeper into this place and uncover its secrets to find out what's really happening.
 Interact with the world to progress

 Inside the outpost, you will find that many...

store.name: Milki Delivery
store.short: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.
store.about:
Explore a charming countryside as a young bike courier named Neha. In this short but satisfying adventure,  playable entirely with your mouse , you'll deliver milk bottles , gather food for your pet cow Milki, meet friendly and intriguing characters, and help the community by completing a variety of small quests.
 Deliver Milk 🐮 

 You and Milki are starting a dairy delivery service! Earn money, collect resources, upgrade your barn, and slowly grow your business.
 Explore the countryside 🌻 

 Lush meadows, green forests, a glittering ocean: this land has so much beauty to discover! To find every little secret and meet everyone, you'll need to upgrade your bike and choose your path wisely.
 Reconnect the Community 💌 

 Once known as "the land of cows", this region has slowly been deserted after a mysterious event that affected all of the cattle. Delivery after delivery, the residents will tell you more about their past as you build a future together!
 Features 
 ✅ What Milki Delivery offers:
 A short adventure:  3-5h of beautiful landscapes, light resource management, gentle decisions, and short dialogues.

 A fully mouse-driven experience: Click to control Neha throughout her journey and to interact with the world.

 Simple game mechanics : Choose your path, sell milk, gather ingredients, and complete little quests.

 A cozy mood : Summer vibes, hand-drawn side-scrolling landscapes, cute characters, and lovely music!

 Everything is kept simple with no possibility of failure : play at your own pace!

 ❌ What Milki Delivery does NOT offer:
 No big odyssey  with...

store.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
store.short: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
store.about:
PRE-PURCHASE CONTENT 
 Pre-purchase STRANGER THAN HEAVEN to get the “Dosu: Kagekiri” weapon to use in-game*.

 FACE DOWN FATE 
 A fifty-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. San Francisco, 1915. Our story begins as a young boy sneaks aboard a mysterious ship in the dead of night. 

 His name? Makoto Daito. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto's world is one of harsh persecution, a fate cruely cast upon him simply because of his Asian heritage.

 After losing both of his parents and finding himself completely alone, Makoto, in an act of desperation, decides to risk it all and travel to his mother's birthplace. If the United States won't accept him for who he is, maybe Japan will...

 With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life. What awaits our young stowaway in Japan? And where will the years take him next?

 5 ERAS, 5 CITIES 
 The story unfolds across a version of Japan that may have existed in another life altogether, immersing you in 5 sprawling cities, each modeled after real locations of their respective eras.

 1915, Kokura, Fukuoka: home of what was said to be one of the world’s largest foundries, a smoke-scorched town bursting with the passion of hard-driven, equally fiery workers.
 1929, Kure, Hiroshima: a port town dominated by Japan’s largest naval arsenal and heavily influenced by the presence of yakuza organizations.
 1943, Minami, Osaka:...

store.name: ROB RUN
store.short: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.
store.about:
ONLY REAL PLAYERS
 Every cop and every criminal is a living breathing human with their own agenda. And with 5,000 players around you, any situation can quickly get out of control. The cops are everywhere, and they pose a real threat. So, if an open fight is too dangerous, you can always find another way to get what you want.

 CLANS AND POWER
 You can survive on your own, but you can only thrive by working together. Create your own crime family or join an existing clan. Assign roles, organize raids, take control of territories, wage gang wars, and negotiate truces. In a place where anyone can betray you, reliable allies are your most valuable asset.

 NO ROOM FOR ERROR
 You risk losing absolutely everything every minute. Someone can easily take what's yours, but the same is true the other way around. To survive, you have to be able to plan, make quick decisions, and pull the trigger at the right moment.

 BRUTAL CRIMINAL UNDERWORLD
 Bank robberies, raids on rivals' hideouts, police chases, and bloody shootouts. Every day is a struggle for resources and influence. The only things that can get you anywhere are strength and cunning.

 YOUR HOME IS YOUR CASTLE
 Create your own hideout. Build and upgrade your base, store loot and vehicles, and place workbenches and safes. But remember: the more lavish your refuge, the more intruders you're going to have.

 TILL THE SERVER WIPES US OUT
 In just one week, you can go from being a regular thug to the boss of the server's largest organization. And then start over — with new experience, allies, and a more ambitious plan to seize...

store.name: Orion Blue
store.short: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.
store.about:
Orion Blue is a relaxing fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet.
 Play actively, or enjoy fishing at your own pace with idle progression.
 Discover a peaceful world and build your own life on Orion Blue.

 Explore the beautiful planet Orion Blue 
 Discover diverse fish species and mysterious lifeforms.
 Catch fish to earn money, or process them into valuable resources.

 Enjoy fishing across diverse regions. 
 Each area offers its own unique atmosphere and discoveries.
 Fish at your own pace in stunning environments and work toward completing your collection.

 Meet the residents of the planet 
 Orion Blue is home to many residents.
 Many of them are around your age.
 Talk with them and slowly build meaningful relationships.

 From friendship to romance 
 Each resident has their own daily life, events, and personal stories.
 As you grow closer, they may open up to you—and some relationships may even turn into romance.

 Customize your ship and living space 
 Craft furniture using various materials, apply wallpapers, and freely customize your ship and personal living space.

store.name: Func Key
store.short: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.
store.about:
Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard. 
 Make every key count 
 Shape your board with four kinds of items:
 Function keys : powerful passives that boost your words. Tired of spelling long words? Grab a function key that'll make short words knock your socks off. Strapped for cash? Have your function keys make money for you!

 Key caps : these colorful upgrades don't just buff your favorite letters, they buff their neighbors too! Align them just right to make a chain reaction of color and light across your whole keyboard!

 Tools : reusable gadgets with a few charges each. Tape letters together to form an "ing" key, swap around keys using portals, or disguise your keys to hide them from debuffs.

 Mods : ultra rare items that change the rules of the game. Tell the spellchecker to take a break or trade your energy in for cash, it's up to you to decide.

 Pick your playstyle 
 Choose from any of 6 keyboards to start your run. These aren't simply skins or stat bonuses - each comes with new mechanics, synergies and ways to play.

 Express yourself 
 Customize your keyboard with over 30 cosmetics: shape, color, font, and even sound!

 Features 
 6 playable keyboards

 5 difficulty levels

 85 function keys

 28 consumables

 32 cosmetics

 16 bosses

 12 mods

 endless mode

 daily challenges

store.name: The Red Bells Lament
store.short: One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and royal knights. They're to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake.
store.about:
A ruthless battle between humans and vampires is about to unfold.

 ■Story
 The Redbell Tree scrapes the sky, standing proudly in the heart of Hemeria, a land of sunlight.
 In a land ruled by a monarchy for generations, humans lived in peace and tranquility.
 That is, until the dawn of the day the world was dyed red.
 On that day, vampires laid waste to Hemeria.
 They preyed on, devoured, and devastated its inhabitants.
 A great many people would go on to mourn their loved ones, their families and friends, for the rest of their lives.
 One particular town of Hemeria bore such a tragedy.
 A single girl was left alone in despair and disgrace.
 She vowed revenge, and grew into one of Hemeria's finest vampire hunters.
 And one day, she became a member of the Elpis 7; those who inspired a light of hope in its people.
 One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and royal knights awaiting her.
 The hunters assembled receive an order from the monarch.
 They are to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires.
 A shiver of anticipation crackles through her at the opportunity she's been waiting for her whole life.
 However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake.
 Pawns are sent forth, discarded, hidden out of sight...
 And just how many will remain when this all comes to an end?

 ■System
 The Mission
 Throughout the story, the heroine will be confronted with various decisions to make.
 In order to complete each mission, she must weigh her options...

store.name: XenoFeels
store.short: You are a lone space customs officer. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!
store.about:
A space customs simulator. You need to compare photographs and documents of aliens with their appearance and vehicles in order to find differences and identify the imposter.
 Spot the differences! 
 There's ALWAYS something that gives a terrorist away: an error in the documents, a poor disguise, fake license plates, or prohibited objects hidden in the car. Use these clues to expose the impostors! 

 Use the gun! 
 You have the right to use your service shotgun and no responsibilities! What could be better? Shoot at anything that seems suspicious. Don't worry about innocent victims; they can easily be written off as "collateral damage"...

 Try not to lose your mind! 
 The job of a space customs officer is hard and exhausting, so don't be surprised if... strange things start happening to you by the end of the day. Remember, it’s okay to hear voices in your head — just don't talk to them!

store.name: VacBot Simulator
store.short: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.
store.about:
Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

 VacBot Simulator lets you take control of a robotic vacuum that has one task: clean the floor. This task is not always pleasant, that's why humans don't like doing it. Suck up interactive dust, mop the tougher stains and pick up clutter to prove that you are worth the investment. 

 You are not a basic vacuum, though. You have achieved a higher level of consciousness and have your own opinions on life and your purpose.

 MULTIPLE MODELS AND ENVIRONMENTS
 Explore different floorplans, try out different vacuum models and experience their unique personalities. Each vacuum has different set of features best suited for tackling messes and obstacles of their home. 

 REALISTIC SIMULATION
 Dust is annoying in real life, and it's no different here. Particles of dust behave independently of each other, you are moving them around as you pass through the household. Larger pieces of dust require stronger suction, more stubborn stains need to be mopped. Manage the suction strength and water output for best results, but watch out for your battery and water tank levels.

 PLAY AS YOU WANT
 Humans are not supervising you, they only care about the final result. Don't stress and take your time, if you want to see how effective you can be, though, there are leaderboards where you can compare your results to others on...

store.name: Blind Phobia
store.short: You are blind and trapped in an infinite hospital corridor. Use your guide cane and other senses to detect anomalies, question illusions, and find a way out.
store.about:
You are Blind! 
 You wake up in a hospital in a blind person's body. Seeing nothing but darkness, you feel something is in the room with you. But don't worry, you have your guide cane, the only thing anchoring you to reality.

 Gameplay
 A first-person psychological horror game. No jump scares 

 Explore a repeating hospital corridor that subtly changes on each floor

 Use a guide cane to feel the floor, walls, and tactile paving, listen carefully to footsteps, echoes, and ambient sounds

 Rules
 At the end of each hallway, you must choose either exit from the left or the right door.
 Making the wrong decision will reset your progress or place you in more dangerous situations.

store.name: Anomaly Corp.
store.short: A classic single-player horror game where you have nothing but a flashlight that slows your movement. Uncover fully voiced audio logs and multiple different endings while escaping from Amusden Corp's Complex.
store.about:
Escape from eight different levels, each with their own unique obstacles to overcome and anomalies to avoid.

 Use your flashlight, but be wary of how it limits your movement. 

 Find fully voiced hidden audio logs throughout the map and uncover the truth behind the anomalies, and achieve multiple different endings.

store.name: Very Safe Dino Park 🦖
store.short: A chaotic 1 to 4 player dinosaur park sim where feeding the dinos, cleaning the mess, and surviving the chaos are all part of the job.
store.about:
Welcome to the Very Safe Dino Park.

 Build, manage, and barely survive your own prehistoric theme park in this chaotic 1 to 4 player co-op simulator. Feed dinosaurs, clean up “incidents,” keep the guests under control, and hold everything together with duct tape and poor decisions.
 Nothing can go wrong but life finds a way.

 Open the gates. Sell the tickets. Pretend everything is fine.
 Behind the scenes?
 Dinosaurs are getting hungry

 Guests are getting annoying

 Systems are definitely failing

 Keep the park running, or watch it spiral into a very expensive mistake.

 Your dinosaurs are incredible, majestic and constantly seconds away from ruining your life.
 Step into enclosures to feed and manage them

 Clean up mountains of poop

 Keep them calm before they break out

 Tranquilise anything with too many teeth and a bad attitude

 If they get hungry, they will hunt. You are not special.

 Guests are the reason you’re here and everything is under control!
 Sell tickets and overpriced merch

 Keep vending machines stocked

 Clean up litter, spills, and suspicious limbs

 Deal with troublemakers however you see fit

 You can escort them out politely. Or speed up the food chain.

 And it will break. Constantly.
 Scrub bloodstains and mystery puddles

 Keep the park clean

 Turn dino poop into biofuel

 Keep the power on at all costs

 Because when the power goes out… the fences do too.

 Start small. Mess up fast. Expand anyway.
 Unlock new dinosaurs

 Build enclosures

 Add facilities and decorations

 Automate repetitive tasks

 Turn your park into a world-class...

store.name: CRACK
store.short: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.
store.about:
CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends work together to uncover what's inside a mysterious giant egg. 

 There is an egg.
 It is very big.
 Your job is simple: crack it open. Don’t ask why.

 Who built this laboratory?
 Why are you here?
 Unlock hidden rooms and upgrade your tools throughout the facility.

 The Egg reacts to you.
 Listen closely.
 Find out what's inside. Whatever happens after that is above your pay grade.
 I’m building CRACK in public from Day 1! Follow the development on social media, and tell me what to develop next.

store.name: Cat Parents
store.short: FROM STRAY TO HOME: cat rescue simulator. The streets are full of dangers for these sweet, defenseless creatures. Save cats, give them love, care, and a place to call home. Become a true cat parent alone or with your friend. Discover what true happiness feels like.
store.about:
Your heart is full of love. The city is full of cats who need it.
 Save abandoned, homeless, and helpless cats. Give them care, earn their trust, and help them find a forever home - or keep them with you and build a safe sanctuary where they can live happily. Play alone or together with your own team of cat parents.

 SAVE CATS 
 Locate cats in distress on the open city map. Ride your bike on a rescue mission. Use the right tools and gadgets. Save poor, sweet little animals.
 Every rescue is unique. Every life matters.

 TAKE CARE OF THEM 
 Bring rescued cats home and give them gentle care: 
 • wash dirty and scared cats 
 • treat illnesses 
 • feed them 
 • help them feel safe again

 BUILD YOUR CAT PARADISE 
 Turn your home into a true cat sanctuary.
 • build climbing structures, tunnels, beds, and houses
 • decorate and expand your space
 • create a cozy, living ecosystem for your cats
 Your home grows together with your family. Live in a cat paradise.

 MAKE OTHER FAMILIES HAPPY 
 Not every cat stays forever.
 Carefully choose adoptive families for your rescued pets and send them to loving homes - make others happy too.

 TEAM OF CAT PARENTS 
 Are your friends kind, caring, and ready to help?

 Invite them to your world and play together:
 • rescue cats as a team
 • share responsibilities and resources
 • build and manage your sanctuary together

 Because saving lives is even better when you’re not alone.

store.name: Totally Secure Airport
store.short: Totally Secure Airport is a chaotic co-op sim where you play as an airport security guard. Search through weird luggage and decide who flies and who cries. Documents? Check. Suitcases? Shuffle. Find troublemakers with your friends, but be quick - the airplane is taking off soon!
store.about:
DIVE INTO THE CO-OP MAYHEM

 Why ruin someone's vacation alone when you can do it with friends? Grab your squad and split the duties: one person scans, one barks orders, and everyone else tries not to lose their minds.
 DIG THROUGH WEIRD STUFF

 Treat every suitcase like a loot box from a fever dream. You’ll find definitely-not-illegal things hidden in most unexpected places. It’s messy, it’s nosy, and it’s definetely glorious.
 FLEX YOUR AIRPORT AUTHORITY

 You’re the king of the metal detector, so start acting like it! Feel like confiscating a cactus? Do it. Want to deport a guy just because his passport photo is too smug? No problem. Your scanner, your rules.
 FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS

 Don’t overthink it. There is no need to make everything exceptional. Just follow simple instructions you’ve been given. Spot the banned stuff, stamp the papers, and keep the line moving.
 FEATURES
 Search passengers together with up to 4 players

 An airport where you must ensure total security

 Crowds of impatient passengers

 Contraband in suitcases

 A cute little dog

 A stun gun

 Name badges

 The fate of vacations is in your hands

store.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
store.short: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.
store.about:
In a towering space station split by wealth and corruption, your business runs on merchandise with flexible origins. You’re a former scavenger who secured a storefront thanks to a generous loan and questionable timing. Now rent is rising, factions are watching, and most of your best margins live in legal gray zones. 

 You never really know who’s on the other side of the counter. Today’s customer could be a security fisher for evidence, a revolutionary seeking leverage, or a fallen elite testing your usefulness. Every sale is a gamble. Approve it, refuse it, report it, or look away; someone is always taking notes. Reputation buys access and protection, but it also paints a target on your back. On this station, every client is a potential profit and a potential trouble.

 Start as a gunsmith, chemist, water merchant, fence, farmer, or from absolute rock bottom. Every product line has its own profit curve and its own way of ruining you, weapons bring inspections, chemicals bring addiction, water brings liability, contraband brings raids. Some trades need heavy machinery and permits, others just a good hiding spot and a straight face. The better the margins, the worse the consequences when something goes wrong. You’re not choosing a theme for your shop, you’re choosing which kind of trouble you’re willing to monetize.

 Every item you stock carries its own risks. Cigarette packs need visual inspection before resale. Water must be tested and filtered. Weapons require permits and modifications. Profitable chemicals rely on closely guarded recipes. Rare items need proper...

store.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
store.short: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.
store.about:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins. 
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.
 ■Explore the World on a Planetary Scale
 Soar the skies with your airship—the Highwind—and explore a vast, interconnected world. Choose where to drop and skydive down to areas of interest across a wide variety of biomes, cities, and remote frontiers.
 ■An Iconic Ensemble, Fully United
 Fight alongside a roster of unique companions, including newly playable party members Cid Highwind and Vincent Valentine. Each character brings distinct combat roles and abilities to the fray, greatly expanding your strategic options.
 ■Refined Action and Strategy
 Experience the series’ iconic hybrid of real‑time action and command‑based combat in its most polished form yet. Seamlessly switch between party members, issue commands in Tactical Mode, and unleash powerful abilities and synergies to overcome colossal threats.
 ■Deep Customization and Builds
 Prepare your team for the battles ahead...

store.name: NBA 2K27
store.short: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.
store.about:
The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER*, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

 THE CITY 
 Put The City on your back and lead the next generation of MyPLAYERs, representing every hooper, fueled by basketball. Let your passion power your unique style on and off the court, team up with friends at the all-new Crew HQ, and dominate the courts at The REC, Park, and beyond. 

 MyCAREER 
 For the first time in MyCAREER, play through NBA history and compete against legends from five iconic eras, and experience a legacy-defining story in the Modern Era. Create a MyPLAYER that transcends playstyles and rewrite the record book on your way to the Hall of Fame.

 POWERED BY ProPLAY® 
 Master your skills with new gameplay animations directly translated from real NBA action. Use an array of ProPLAY® features to cook defenders with ankle-breaking crossovers, show off your range with enhanced shooting mechanics, and become a matchup nightmare every time you step on the court.

 MyTEAM 
 Collect your favorite NBA and WNBA stars with ease and build a fantasy squad for the ages. Grow your collection and assemble endless lineup combinations. Take control of your MyTEAM and put it to the test in single-player and multiplayer modes, with challenges inspired by NBA performances.

 *Internet connection and NBA 2K Account required to redeem and use bonus content. Terms apply. 
 Play Now, MyNBA, and The W are available offline. All other game modes and features require Internet connection, may require online account...

store.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
store.short: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!
store.about:
You are the Grand Inquisitor now! Restore the Town and lead your undead army into battle to save the realm from a zombie apocalypse. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper 2 - the sequel to the original, unhinged classic!

 Manage your own medieval graveyard 

 Automate your production like never before

 Lead your zombie army into battle and fortify the Town against the undead

 Rebuild The Town and milk its residents for maximum profits

 A world full of unhinged humour, grotesque characters and a twisted story

 Build and manage your own medieval graveyard. Harvest as much flora, fauna, and human remains as you can to build extraordinary machinery, automate production, and expand your graveyard for pure profit.

 Become the Inquisitor and lead your undead army into battle to save the Kingdom from a zombie apocalypse. Build towers and fortifications, craft powerful armour and weapons, arm and train your not-so-smart troops, and slash your way to victory!

 Help the townsfolk restore their homes and turn their problems into revenue. Complete quests throughout the city, as your undead workers take care of the heavy lifting behind the scenes. With zombie-based automation and structured systems, you can transform local efforts into a scalable and profitable operation.

store.name: Last Harbor
store.short: Zombie Apocalypse On A Boat. You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?
store.about:
Humanity has fallen. The undead roam the land and the few remaining survivors have taken to the sea in search of refuge. To survive, they must maintain and upgrade their boats, venturing back to the land they once called home in search of resources, loot and sustenance. But every expedition could be their last and it’s not just the zombies that are out for blood… 

 Your home, away from home: 

 Your boat is your lifeline. Your mobile base, your means of traversal and your last stand against the horror unravelling in the world.
 Upgrade your vessel to withstand raids, improve your crafting capabilities, house fellow survivors and navigate the world more effectively. 
 But keep in mind, while the sea keeps the undead at bay, you can only survive offshore for so long.

 The San Juan Islands of Washington State 
 Inspired by true events of spending the lockdown of 2020 on a boat stuck in the beautiful San Juan Islands of Washington state. Fishing, exploration, the feeling of dread while surrounded by beauty, and walking around quaint, seemingly abandoned town centers while trying to avoid other people. 

 We aspire to replicate this feeling of isolation as you navigate the abandoned remains of a cluster of islands off the US coast, teeming with the undead. Familiar weapons, zombie survival mechanics, crafting, basebuilding and exploration, set against a unique backdrop where your “base” is mobile and essential for survival and exploration. 
 Anchor next to an unexplored island, launch your dinghy and venture ashore. Stay alert of your surroundings, as other players won’t...

store.name: Split Brain Samsara
store.short: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!
store.about:
In Split Brain Samsara , you and a friend control the same character. One controls the character’s movements and interactions with the physical world, while the other sees different things and interacts with the spiritual realm.
 Together, you must try to escape a massive station, understand what happened to you, and choose your fate.

 Every part of the station to figure out what happened: where are the people who used to live here? What were you doing here? Why are there two of you in one body?

 Puzzles and riddles by analyzing the clues seen by each player, an effective communication will be the key to success.

 A spiritual world, between reality and the unconscious, where fragments of memories might resurface.

 A unique cooperative adventure—sharing the same body!

 New mechanics that lead to even more surprising situations

 100% hand-crafted environments and levels

 Two worlds to explore, each filled with mysteries and challenges

 The game must be played online and requires both players to communicate to each other.

store.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
store.short: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.
store.about:
You are invited to join Unicorn Academy!

 Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and bond with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. 
 Step into the magical world of Unicorn Academy and begin your very own adventure! Create your own first-year student at the academy and call upon the help of Unicorn Academy’s favorite characters. Groom, race and bond with your unicorn. Embark on missions to stop Ravenzella’s evil plot.  

 Island of Magic Features:  
 Forge Friendship Bonds 
 The closer you become with your unicorn, the more you discover their powers, skills and personality. 

 Discover Unicorn Island 
 Discover hidden paths of the island and the academy. Wield the elemental magic of unicorns to beat challenges and mini games. 

 Become part of the Team 
 Switch between your character and your favorite heroes! You play as your own created character, a first year at Unicorn Academy. Whilst exploring, you are joined by Sophia, Ava, Layla, Isabel, Valentina and Rory and wield the magic of their unicorns! 

 Dress Up Riders and Unicorns 
 Change your hair, change your clothes, change your unicorn! Freshen up your look with cool outfits and hairstyles.

store.name: My Little Ranch
store.short: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Breed one-of-a-kind horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.
store.about:
Turn the bottom of your screen into a small living ranch. Transparent and click-through, it stays out of the way while you work or browse. Prefer a regular window? Play it windowed or full screen with the mountain scenery and let it run.

 Every horse is built from real coat colors and markings: bay, seal brown, black, gray and more, leg markings from a coronet up to full stockings, a star, stripe or bald face, tobiano and sabino patterns, and mealy or dark muzzles, plus mane, eye and hoof colors. All of it is rolled for each horse, with over 500,000 possible combinations, and horses come in three builds: the classic Stock horse, the big, sturdy Draft horse and the slim, quick Light horse. Rarity isn't a hidden number: it shows in how a horse looks. A Common horse is plain. A Legendary one wears the rarest traits.
 Foals you raise only show their coat. Their markings and rarity are revealed when they grow up.

 The Marketplace offers four new horses every hour. They arrive fully grown, and some come with a known pedigree.

 Buyers drop by, each looking for a specific kind of horse. Show them one you raised and get an offer above the market price, or try to haggle for more.

 Breed a mare and a stallion, and each foal inherits its traits from its parents. Before you pair them, the breeding screen shows the exact odds for every trait.

 Watch for surprise traits from a grandparent or a mutation, and follow every horse's family tree back to its grandparents.

 Your horses graze, move, and react in real time.
 Feed them hay, apples, oats and more, keep them happy, and watch...

store.name: Book Nook
store.short: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.
store.about:
Build tactile, satisfying miniature diorama scenes piece by piece in Book Nook. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and tiny details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful reward of every detail falling into place, as you slowly unfold memories with each diorama you build.  

 Zen Puzzles
 Take things slow and enjoy the process. There’s no timers, no pressure. Just the quiet pleasure of figuring out where each piece belongs and that gentle “click” when everything fits.  Finishing Touches

store.about:
Terminus: Day Zero is a short zombie survival adventure about the first day of the outbreak, seen through the eyes of Daisy, a young girl who wakes up to an empty house.
 At first the house is just too quiet. Daisy calls for Mom and Dad, and nobody calls back. Then the dead find a way in.

 Daisy can't fight back. What she has is what every kid knows: the best hiding places in the house, and which doors still close. Squeeze under a bed and hold your breath while something shuffles past, close enough to touch. Shut the door behind you, back away from it, and hope it holds.

 This is not a story about soldiers, or survivors with a plan. It is about a girl who doesn't understand what is happening, only that the people outside are wrong somehow.
 Daisy talks to herself to stay brave, the way kids do when they're scared and trying not to show it. Mom and Dad are out there somewhere. Should she stay put and wait for help, or get out while she still can?

 Daisy's street is full of strangers now. Every one of them was somebody once: a neighbor who waved from the porch, a face she passed on the way to school. Some stand in the yards as if they forgot where they were going. Others kneel over the people who didn't make it. In the thin fog, with cars sitting where their owners left them, across the street has never looked so far away.

 Sooner or later, hiding isn't enough. Daisy can't stay put and wait to be found. She has to get out. So Daisy runs. She knows every yard and fence around here better than anything chasing her.
