 Perhaps on your journey you will meet colonists seeking passage to the New World. Help them and you may found new cities together.
 Do battle with pirates and hostile nations! Or become a pirate yourself and set out in search of rich merchant ships to seize.

 With a large enough warship, you can bombard a hostile city to silence its shore batteries, then land marines to capture the port!

 When it's...

store.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
store.short: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.
store.about:
Adventure across four revamped worlds full of naughty baddies and menacing boss fiights while collecting delicious onions to keep Volvy at extreme levels of awesome! Whip out your big hand for whatever comes your way - from helicoptering over huge chasms and grinding radical rails to dashing through the skies and fisting your way deep underground. And just when you think you've met your match, scarf down a bundle of onions to transform into the muscular Swolvy and rage your way out of any situation.

There's some sort of story too. Basically some warlocks released some slime and Volvy is stopping them. Also, they kidnapped his friends.

 Adventure is in Your Big Hand
Any ol' video game mascot can run, jump and stomp their way through levels but Volvy and his big hand take it up a notch! Use your oversized appendage to hover, grind, burrow, and smash through every enemy, obstacle, and secret passage. 

 Reslimed and Recolored
Every pixel from the original Volvy's Adventure and its previous re-releases has been meticulously redrawn, redesigned, and splashed with dazzling color by the members of the original development team that are no longer incarcerated.

 More New Content, Less Health Warnings
Enjoy redesigned minigames between each level that no longer encourage children to smoke cigarettes!

store.name: Incremental RTS
store.short: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.
store.about:
Build. Scale. Deploy. 
 Start with scraps. End with armies that flood the map.
 In Incremental RTS you don’t command units. You build the production machine, pick the upgrades path, balance economics and decide how your army grows. 
 The classic RTS fantasy of just spawning a huge force and sending it, except the “sending it” part happens on its own.

 Choose your path 
 Specialize in swarms, artillery, snipers, tanks, or massive unstoppable units. Mix them or go all-in. Every path scales differently, and the enemy always has challenges for you. Adapt or get overrun. Some runs collapse early. Others spiral into unstoppable chaos.

 Every unit matters 
 Early units never fully retire. As the game progresses they unlock new abilities, synergies, and scaling hooks that can turn “trash” into core pieces of your late-game army. How well you keep them relevant is part of the decision-making.

 Key Features 
 Semi-idle RTS with zero micromanagement

 Massive auto-battles with hundreds to thousands of units

 Incremental scaling and exponential army growth

 Multiple distinct army archetypes and upgrade paths

 300+ upgrades that actually change how you play

 Low-tier units remain relevant throughout the game

 Enemy surges that pressure every build

 Hand-drawn paper aesthetic

store.name: Sol One
store.short: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.
store.about:
You're alone on Mars.
 The mission is over. Your crew left you behind. You've got a pressure suit, whatever you can pull out of the ground, and a long way to go before you see Earth again. There's a rocket between you and home. You just have to build it first.
 Sol One is a first-person open-world survival game that tries to get the science right. It's for people who like grounded, science-driven survival where the problem-solving is the point. Your oxygen, power, and food all come from machines you set up and maintain, and keeping them running is a must for survival.

 Build it up from the dirt
 Mine iron, copper, silica, ice, and uranium out of the red planet. Run the raw materials through smelters and fabricators and manufacture the parts you need to turn a cramped shelter into a thriving base. The tech tree gives you a long road from scraping by to running a base that mostly takes care of itself.

 A planet that wants you dead
 Mars is doing its best to kill you the whole time. The surface runs out to the horizon in every direction, broken up by deep canyons, old craters, mountains, and fields of rock and coarse regolith you have to pick your way across. The sky behaves like the real thing, from rusty daylight to a cold blue sunset to the gorgeous Milky Way after dark. Dust storms brew on the horizon and roll in over the ridge, and your solar panels drop off, visibility closes in, and the comfortable margins you were working with are suddenly gone until it passes.

 Beyond the airlock
 Drive out across the surface to find what's worth finding, or send your autonomous...

store.name: Football Manager 27
store.short: Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics as the manager of the world’s greatest football clubs. FM27 is where footballing beliefs become reality in a living breathing football world that blends strategy with RPG in the ultimate sports simulation game.
store.about:
Every fan believes they could do it differently. In FM27 belief isn’t a hot take, it’s a story waiting to happen. 

Step into a living, breathing football universe where every decision is yours to make.  

Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you take a chance on the academy prospect. Maybe you sell the star who just doesn’t get your vision. 

Train your team to work as one. Build a tactical blueprint that’s unmistakably yours. Then lead your team out to admiration from the stands as you take your place on the touchline. 

Match day. React to everything the opposition throws at you. Beat their press. Fill the box. And throw the kitchen sink. 

Because footballing history won’t write itself. 

Every decision could be the one to change everything. So chase the vision only you can see.  
Whatever happens, you’ll remember the calls that got you there. 

Football Manager 27. Make The Call.  

 What’s new for FM27?

 Experience a new dimension to squad building with all-new Tactical Effectiveness that measures how well-equipped your players are to deliver your footballing vision, while refreshed training puts even more focus on player and team development.

 Exploit the gaps you see in the opposition defence with Tactical Tweaks that deliver a new layer of influence from the touchline.

 Experience every fixture as a richer piece of football theatre thanks to upgrades to crowds, stadiums and environments that elevate the stage for your players to perform on.

 Sit defenders down with more attacking precision and expression, with flair and...

store.name: Dear Passengers
store.short: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.
store.about:
WORLD’S WORST AIRLINE IS HIRING! 
 You and your friends are the crew. Your job is to deliver passengers and cargo to their destination. Preferably in one piece. While one of you pilots the plane, the others keep the cabin together, serve the passengers, and deal with whatever goes wrong before it gets much worse. 

 WELCOME TO BUDGET PREMIUM! 
 Passengers expect food, drinks, and a smooth flight. Try to provide at least two of those.

 MORE TROUBLE, MORE MONEY! 
 Before takeoff, choose which passengers and cargo to bring onboard. The bigger the payout, the more trouble it usually causes. Some cargo is hard to handle, some passengers are hard to please, and some flights start going wrong before you even leave the ground.

 SAFETY IS OUR TOP-3 PRIORITY! 
 Trouble can start anywhere onboard. Keep the passengers under control, protect the cargo, and do whatever it takes to stop one problem from turning into a full-blown disaster. Not every solution is elegant, and not every passenger stays onboard.

 ROUGH AIR AHEAD! 
 Weather can turn a normal flight into a disaster. Turbulence and air pockets throw passengers, luggage, and anything else that is loose around the cabin. One bad turn can send the whole plane into chaos.

 KEY FEATURES 
 Online co-op with friends

 Pilot the plane or work inside the cabin

 Physics-based passengers, cargo, and cabin chaos

 Dynamic weather, turbulence, and air pockets

 Risky passengers and high-paying cargo

store.name: After Hue
store.short: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!
store.about:
After Hue is a charming puzzle-platformer where an adorable chameleon embarks on a grand adventure!

 Discover the secrets hidden within the colors!

 Change colors, alter states, and solve the puzzles in your path!

 Key Features
 Adorable animal characters

 Approx. 1 hour of playtime

 A wordless gameplay experience

 Dynamic color-shifting mechanics

store.name: Casualties: Unknown
store.short: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
store.about:
Survive a Harsh World  
 Each layer brings its own challenges, adapt and descend. 

 Simulated Limb and Cardiovascular Systems  
 Injuries are unavoidable. You will have to bandage yourself, fight infected wounds, and stabilize blood loss before losing consciousness. Additionally, your mood can greatly affect your chances of survival, too much doom and gloom will make your life harder. 

 Craft to Survive  
 As a creature capable of reason, using tools will allow you to travel the cavernous layers more efficiently. In case you start bleeding out, the flora will provide great resources to patch yourself up. 

 Explore at Your Own Risk  
 Previous expeditions have left some good loot behind. But even helpful things can prove to be your death.

 Uncover the Truth  
 What actually lies at the end of this journey? And what becomes of you if you are to succeed?

 Features 
 An entirely simulated cardiovascular and limb damage system

 Character traits to increase on your run: Intelligence, Strength, and Resilience

 Robust crafting mechanics to increase your odds of survival

 3 characters with their own distinct playstyles

 11 layers of an alien planet with their own challenges and dangers

 300 items to find on your runs

 Adjustable loot and danger values accessible on the main menu

store.name: Void Step
store.short: Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet. Drop any audio file and the game builds a first-person neon obstacle course from its beats, energy, and rhythm. Jump, slide, and strafe through your music. No music files? Fetch from Newgrounds directly! or build and share levels in the editor.
store.about:
You are a runner in a neon void. The silent world pulses once again to the music you bring. Race against time, against gravity, against everyone else.

 Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet.
 Drop any audio file and Void Step analyzes its beats, energy, and structure. Calm sections slow down. Drops accelerate. Every jump, every slide, every obstacle lands on a musical beat. Your actions ARE the rhythm. Dubstep builds frantic gauntlets. Lo-fi builds flowing runs. The same game feels completely different with every song.

 Build your own levels in a full 3D editor packed with platforms, hazards, and music-reactive elements. Upload to the community and watch players worldwide compete for the top spot on your level's leaderboard. Play what others have built. Rate, compete, repeat.

 Feature list:
 Drop any song and the game builds a full level from its rhythm and energy.

 Every action lands on a musical beat. Your inputs ARE the music.

 Calm verses slow the world down. Drops accelerate everything. The game breathes with the song.

 Bundled music with with global leaderboards.

 Full 3D level editor with community sharing and per-level leaderboards.

 Fetch songs directly from Newgrounds by ID, no files needed.

 Assist mode so every player can engage on their own terms.

 Customizable game colors.

store.name: Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.
store.short: An unemployed dad and his college-student daughter set out to make a living as travel influencers. Puzzle out destinations from clues, pin them on the world map, and grow your channel with videos: geo-guessing meets streamer sim. Aim for one million followers, with 200+ history and geography trivia.
store.about:
The world is at your fingertips. — Track down where the story takes place, and drop your pin! 
 『Dad's Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.』 is a Geo-guessing exploration sim with a twist, set in real-world tourist spots and historical landmarks . Travel the globe alongside Shiro and his daughter Sara, thrill your live-stream audience, and aim for 1,000,000 followers .

 Real-World Locations: Explore actual cultural and natural heritage sites across the globe.

 Epic Narrative: Over 200 episodes ranging from history to modern-day mysteries.

 Unique Simulation: Manage budget, followers, and live-chat interaction simultaneously.

 The Power of Family: Experience the growth and drama of a father-daughter duo.

store.name: TARAE: The Unbound
store.short: TARAE: The Unbound is an action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy world. Explore Taegwido, an island born upon the shattered boundaries of the Six Realms, and master the distinct combat styles and builds of six unique classes.
store.about:
Sever Fate.  
 TARAE: The Unbound is a top-down action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy.
 Mercilessly carve your way through swarms of enemies, master the patterns of powerful foes, and overcome every challenge standing in your way.
 Cut Down the Horde Use a wide arsenal of skills and chained attacks to tear through the battlefield. Experience a combat system that hits as hard as it looks.

 Boss Battles Built to Be Mastered Learn the patterns and tricks of menacing boss monsters. Seize your moment to dodge, counter, and carve your path to glory.

 Relentless Action, Merciless Impact Every hit lands with satisfying force, making each fight exhilarating to tear through a mass of enemies.

 Combat Shaped by Your Decisions Combine class skills, traits, support skills, and gear into a build and playstyle that's all your own.

 Six Seekers, One Intertwined Tale Travel with the six Seekers, each carrying their own karma and purpose. Through countless trials, seek true understanding to become true allies.

 Journey Across Taegwido, at the Shattered Boundaries of the Six Realms Step into a world that reimagines Eastern myth, folklore, and traditional aesthetics, where beauty and mystery are entwined with darkness and brutality.

 Each battle and every choice shapes the path to restoring order to the Six Realms.

 Taegwido, an island born upon the collapsed Six Realms 
 "The Sources that can restore the cycle of reincarnation lie scattered across Taegwido." 
 The outcast Agasa shattered the boundaries to break the wheel of reincarnation. From these fractured lands, the island of...

store.name: Sanctuaries
store.short: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!
store.about:
Conquistadors are coming and they're after your gold! Their insatiable greed drives them to sack your temples where your most beautiful treasures are kept. They cannot be reasoned with so it’s up to you to use every means available to repel them!

 Welcome to the Aztec coast : More than forty different levels with unique layouts. Fight in an idyllic setting of sandy beaches and turquoise waters.

 Numerous enemies with different characteristics, resistances and abilities! Meet the speedy scout or face the slow, heavily-armoured veteran. Endure the infuriating tricks of the cunning engineer or suffer a deadly blow from the suicidal sapper!

 Defend yourself by laying traps on walls and floor of your labyrinthine sanctuaries. You must protect your treasure room at all costs!

 Twenty unique traps ! From sharp spikes to poisoned arrows, from burning embers to pools of boiling water or mud, not to mention barricades or giant fans (!), nothing is too extreme to repel the conquistadors.

 Be strategic! There are numerous traps, but you may only select a few. Choose wisely based on the various damage they inflict: physical, fire, water, poison and bleeding.

 Adapt your loadout: Different battlegrounds and varying enemy types mean that there is no perfect one-size-fits-all loadout of traps.

 Experimentation is the key: Upgrade your traps in the workshop with a wide range of enhancements and try different configurations. Be creative!

 Empowered by the Aztec deities, your heroes are the real thing. Your success against the invaders lies with them.

 Six unique heroes : possessing...

store.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
store.short: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.
store.about:
Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel is the first game in the series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel depicting what happened after the 2014 anime film Expelled from Paradise.
 Civilization has been destroyed by the Nano Hazard, a runaway nanomachine disaster, and most of humanity has given up their physical bodies to live on as data in the virtual world of DEVA. Angela Balzac turned her back on that world and chose to live on the surface with her partner, Dingo. Theirs is a story shaped by the conversations they have shared and the choices they have made—and it is your choices that will determine where it leads.

 ■ The story stirs once more, down on the surface
 A.D. 2400. Ever since the Nano Hazard, a catastrophic event that laid waste to the surface world, 98% of humanity has abandoned both the ravaged Earth and their own flesh and blood to migrate to the virtual world of DEVA. Now, a strange new lifeform has suddenly begun sprouting on the surface: the Paraflora. As it spreads at alarming speed, colossal worms have started to appear nearby, attacking people one after another. At the heart of the outbreak lies Svarga, a desert town that was long ago abandoned due to a plague. Meanwhile, an agent of DEVA’s Security Bureau has stolen Grey Goo, a top-secret file holding data on the Nano Hazard, and fled to the surface. Their trail, too, leads to Svarga. And now, in this ghost town shrouded in mystery and conspiracy, several competing agendas are about to converge.

 ■ With the K2-system, Angela’s heart is in your hands!
 In the film, Angela felt the wind on the...

store.name: Your party died again
store.short: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.
store.about:
'Your party died again' is an incremental dungeon crawler with rapid character progression. Allow your party members to do most of the fighting for you as you collect the loot.

 Unlock the Priest, the Ranger and the Mage to create an undefeatable party of heroes. 

 Explore 225 skill nodes within 4 skill trees using unique resources to empower each hero independently.

 Use 8 different abilities tactically to gain an edge or put them on auto cast to sit back and enjoy the ride.

 Fight through 7 different levels with unique monsters and mechanics to overcome. (Estimated playing time of 5 hours)

store.name: Cartel Pilots Wanted
store.short: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.
store.about:
DELIVER SKETCHY CARGO

 After a wild night in paradise, you and your friends wake up on a remote island owned by a cartel. To start your lives anew, you must take to the skies and fly questionable missions for your new “employers”. Take contracts, stack cargo, and deliver it across a vast tropical archipelago.

 COOPERATIVE SMUGGLING

 If you’re going to take shady smuggling flights, you might as well do it with friends, right? Experience the life of a cartel pilot in co-op. Just don’t forget to grab a crate of cold beer before the next mission.

 PREPARE AND MAINTAIN YOUR PLANES

 Get your hands dirty in the hangar to ensure your planes stay airborne and reliable. Yes, it’s a chill smuggler life on these islands, but a well-maintained plane is your only way home.

 STYLE IN THE SKIES, STYLE ON LAND

 Express your style by customizing both your pilot and your aircraft. Choose from a variety of outfits and design custom liveries for your planes. If you’re going to be the most wanted pilots in the region, you might as well look good doing it.

 TROPICAL ARCHIPELAGO AWAITS

 Explore a vast world of sun-drenched islands and breathtaking ocean views. Navigate through clear skies or prepare to show your piloting skills when violent tropical storms hit the area.

store.name: Booster Pack Heroes
store.short: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.
store.about:
OPEN PACKS. SURVIVE THE HORDE. 
 Booster Pack Heroes is an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Discover heroes and spells, upgrade their abilities, and survive endless monster hordes as you fight your way through the realms.

 OPEN PACKS 
 Rip open booster packs, each with its own pool of heroes and spells. Hunt for rare cards and build a collection powerful enough to crush the toughest foes.

 UPGRADE YOUR POWER 
 Survive to earn Mastery. Use it to upgrade your heroes and spells, unlock powerful new abilities, and turn your collection into an unstoppable force.

 SURVIVE THE HORDE 
 Monsters are coming for the tower. Fight through increasingly dangerous waves, unleash devastating abilities, and push your survival as far as you can.

 TRAVEL BETWEEN REALMS 
 Defeat each chapter's boss to unlock new booster packs, heroes, spells, and challenges. Every run feeds the next, giving you more power and letting you survive a bit longer.
 …and there's more to discover beyond the tower. Travel between mysterious planes of existence, each with its own secrets.
 The cycle has repeated countless times.
 You're here to break it.

store.name: Onward! Autobattles
store.short: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onward! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.
store.about:
In Onward!, victory isn't about reflexes or quick reaction times. You make the most important decisions before the battle even begins - when building your army, planning synergies, and positioning units on the board . A good strategy is paramount. Even changing the position of one unit by a single square can decide the outcome of the battle. 

 Once the battle begins, you can see your plan play out. Watch as units execute your strategy, activate abilities, and utilize synergies in automatic battles . Every victory is the result of prior decisions , not quick reactions during combat.

 Each run is procedurally generated, each playthrough unique. Combination of enemies, events, shops, rewards, units and artifacts you will find, special encounters - different every time - is encouraging you to constantly adapt and use what you find to your advantage. 

 During the game, you have to decide your fate depending on what the run brings . You continually build your team, deciding which playstyle is most effective based on what fate has in store for you. Each board brings more opportunities that you must utilize strategically. 

 There is no single best build, but if you make good choices during a run you can end up with an overpowered one!

 The arrangement of units on the board is the most crucial element of the game . Some character classes become stronger when standing next to specific allies or structures. Others start out weak but grow over time. Some require sufficient distance, or open space to activate their abilities. Part of them may look average at first, but they start...

store.name: Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor
store.short: Once upon a time, there was a world so brutal and chaotic, wars would break out left and right, taking the lives of many innocent people on a daily basis. In that world, Alice, who has lost everything, wants to avenge her comrades.
store.about:
"Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor" is an RPG game produced by キリンジェット and published by Hanabi games.

 Once upon a time, there was a world so brutal and chaotic, wars would break out left and right, taking the lives of many innocent people on a daily basis. In that world, Alice, who has lost everything, wants to avenge her comrades, find her little sister, and discover the culprit behind it, with the help of her new shiny demonic armor. Perhaps that search will reveal a plot thicker than she could ever imagine . . .

 Jrpg

 Captivating story

 High freedom of exploration

 Turn-based combat

store.name: Widget Idle
store.short: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)
store.about:
Always playing: your desktop is Widget Idle's controller! 
 Widget Idle turns everything you already do on your computer into game input. Every click, every keypress, every movement of your mouse comes with a little incremental sense of accomplishment.
 Widget Idle gives every click a little extra oomph. Whether you're chatting, editing photos, or writing (copy-pasting)  code, you're always growing your economy. Neat!
 We take particular care in how the game collects and uses data. It only reads the bare minimum it needs to run, and never stores or uploads the context, content or intent of anything you do. (See the appendix) 

 Satisfying animations and gameplay! 
 We carefully designed every interaction you'll have in Widget Idle.
 From big feature unlocks to the smallest page switch, we hope these animations and sounds are ones you'll never want to put down! 

 Ever-evolving desktop companions! 
 Collect 16 adorable desktop widgets and unlock their expected, and unexpected, new features!
 (We are not responsible if you get too attached.)

 Gotta have them all! 
 Explore hidden (and not-so-hidden) mechanics, and collect and curate 100+ unique achievement stamps . (Supports Steam's new achievement system at launch!)
 Display them proudly, show them off to your friends, and tell them just how productive you've been.

 Customize your experience! 
 Widget Idle is a carefully designed and curated experience. That said, we know everyone enjoys games in their own way.
 You're free to adjust:
 Dark/light mode

 7 accessible color palettes

 Window zoom, with quick switching

...

store.name: Grave Mistakes
store.short: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.
store.about:
Good Mourning™ Funeral Home takes pride in serving customers during their most delicate moments. As the most trusted, and only, funeral home in the area, your one-stop shop is vital to the community. Keeping everyone happy also means having enough stock. Running out of fresh meat is not an option… 
 Family Business 
 Grandma has been around ever since this place was built. She’s locked in the basement, and not in a particularly human form, so you will have to fetch her meals. Each day she will request an assortment of body parts from you. Don’t worry, you’ll have an entire shift to prepare for today’s “menu”.
 Opening Hours 
 Good Mourning™ Funeral Home is very much a legitimate business. From dawn to dusk, you will be busy: people coming in for funeral preparations, conducting ceremonies, and of course, embalming. Just keep people away from the back of house. Nobody should have to see what goes on there.

 Prepare Bodies, Make Orders 
 Once the body arrives, there is no time to lose. The body will start decaying, and you have things to do. Replace an arm with a shovel, a leg with a skateboard, and a head is essentially a basketball with a picture on it (depending on who you ask).
 Family Dinner 
 When the day is done, it’s time for family dinner. Everybody gathers round the table down in the basement to watch Grandma feast. You better hope you brought what she craves. If not, one of you will become that evening’s meal.

 Features 
 Online co-op and proximity chat

 Run and manage a ‘respectable’ funeral home

 Chop and clean physics-based bodies

 Deceive families and...

store.name: Voxel Breakers
store.short: Voxel Breakers - a relaxing incremental game where you break voxels, buy and upgrade breaker robots, then watch them break voxels for you faster and faster.
store.about:
Tired of breaking your voxel cube yourself?

 Buy voxel breakers and let them take over the job. In Voxel Breakers, you break voxels and spend them on units that break even more voxels for you.

 Break the cube yourself - upgrade your click power and attack radius so each click breaks more voxels.

 Buy voxel breakers - the game features 20 different units . Some attack up close, while others shoot, drill, jump, launch rockets, bomb from the air, attack with gas, or cut the cube with a laser. Unlock new units, upgrade them, and increase their numbers.

 Choose useful upgrades - different breakers have different strengths: some need accuracy more, some need attack speed, and some need movement speed.

 Upgrade the cube - increase its size and density so stronger units have room to shine.

 Upgrade your luck - increase the chance of rare voxels appearing. They give more points.

 Use prestige - reset your progress to unlock new breakers, new voxel colors, and prestige upgrades.

store.name: CINDER CITY
store.short: CINDER CITY is an open-world cinematic third-person shooter set in a fallen near-future Seoul. Fight alongside allies, push back against overwhelming threats, and reclaim the city from the forces tearing it apart.
store.about:
Take Back Seoul 
 Become a Cinderknight, each with unique abilities, and stand as one of the last lines of defense against the maniacal Hyde group, twisted Creatures, and hostile factions that strike without warning.
 The city has fallen. No ground is safe. Use your abilities, hold your role, and fight to take back what was lost.

 Fight with Tactics 
 Tactical Gear with distinct uses like drones and stealth. Vehicles like bikes, power loader mechs, and aircraft scattered across the open world. Your strategy and loadout decide every fight.

 Choose Your Missions 
 Epic story missions, side missions, and dynamic events fill the open world. Take on missions solo or team up with other players. The choices you make will shape what this city becomes.

 Every Threat. Every Scale. 
 Field bosses, instanced dungeons, massive world raids — the threats in Seoul don't stop, and neither do you.
 Divide roles, execute strategy, and build your character around your playstyle. Whether it's a dungeon run or a full-scale raid, co-op is where it all comes together.

store.name: The Brave Few
store.short: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.
store.about:
The Brave Few is a World War II combined arms combat game.

 Planned for Early Access: 
 6 Roles with 2 sub-roles for each (Pilot (Fighter or Bomber), Navigator, Bombardier, Radio Operator, Flight Engineer, Medic, Gunner)

 2-16 player co-op with the ability to fly or gun in the B-17, or pilot as a P-51-D Escort fighter

 4 B-17F historically based missions with varying difficulties and time of day (Single player or co-op)

 Custom difficulty to disable or enable certain features

 Experience based character and crew stats

 Persistent crew members in Single player that are replaced by new recruits if they die

 A plethora of key-binds, settings, and graphics presets

 Tutorial missions

 In-game VOIP with radio filter

 Ability to repair, heal, revive crewmates, arm bombs, and use the Norden bomb sight to bomb targets

 Enemy flak, and fighters including; BF-109E, FW-190, BF-110, and the ME-410

 Realistic damage, flight, and projectile physics models for aircraft

 The Vision :
 Authentic World War II campaign based on real events and major operations

 The ability to pilot, gun, bomb, drive, or sail each of the vehicles, ships, anti-air, and aircraft that experienced combat during World War II

store.name: BOMBANANA!
store.short: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?
store.about:
BOMBANANA! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?
 MEET YOUR SQUAD! 
 🙈 Blind Monkey: You can’t see the bomb, but you can touch the bomb! 👍 Sadly, you can’t see colors or read screens. You’ll need to rely on your teammates for the rest. 

 🙊 Mute Monkey: You are the only one who can read the bomb disposal manual. If only you could tell the others what you know.

 🙉 Deaf Monkey: You can see the bomb and you can see your friends as they frantically gesture at you. Sadly, you can’t hear a thing, but at this point, would you even want to?

 As you gamble with your friends' lives, you must rely on each other and your monkeys' unique abilities. Communication is key, and there’s no one right way to defuse the bomb. We don’t impose any methods: wave, shout, throw bananas. Working out how you communicate is your job.
 WARNING! 
 Players can and should expect peak amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and desperate body language, placing your friendships in jeopardy. Just because you keep talking, that doesn't mean nobody explodes. Even if you manage to survive the bomb, there's no guarantee your friendship will. Some might call this game "friendslop". We disagree. If anything, it's a new genre: anti-friendslop, or perhaps an argument simulator. 🤔
 We’ll let you be the judge!

 3-Player Co-op - No more, no less. Exactly three...

store.name: Crossfire
store.short: Layla and Cross are two opposing operators, divided by ideology but united in a fragile alliance against a threat neither can survive alone. Tactical freedom meets grounded combat in a narrative-driven cinematic action-adventure.
store.about:
Layla, a gun-for-hire, is on a reconnaissance contract in the Atlas Mountains that quickly devolves into a harrowing struggle she cannot overcome alone. Cross is an opposing operator, trained, lethal, and the last person Layla would choose to trust. But trust isn't the point. Making it out alive is. Fighting for survival and their own humanity, the pair's fraught alliance is the only chance at overcoming the existential threat ahead. 

 GRIPPING CINEMATIC NARRATIVE 
 Experience the journey of Layla and Cross, two opposing operators fighting for survival and their own humanity in a fraught but temporary alliance.

 COVER-BASED SHOOTING EVOLVED 
 Survey your surroundings and dynamically maintain cover with Adaptive Cover, our transformative new cover system. Stealth, engage, reposition, and flank. Together with Cross, use the terrain to outthink, outmaneuver, and overcome your enemies. With Adaptive Cover, the harsh terrain is another weapon in your arsenal.

 HIGH TENSION COMBAT 
 At any moment, a single bullet could prove lethal. Mastering and refining your tactical approach is your key to survival.

 A CINEMATIC LANDSCAPE 
 Experience the harsh, beautiful Atlas Mountains with a genre-defining traversal system. Use the world around you to endure the threats ahead.

store.name: Rock Band Simulator
store.short: A first-person rock band life sim. Play rhythm-based gigs, take shady jobs, gamble, fight, and upgrade your gear and garage. Keep the band together and try to stay in one piece. Whatever happens, you’ve still got a show at nine.
store.about:
Rock Band Simulator is a first-person rock band life sim set in a rough 1990s neighbourhood. You’re the lead guitarist. You’ve got two bandmates, barely any money, and seven days to make something of it.
 Rehearse. Find better equipment. Get on stage. That’s the plan, anyway. You still need to pay for all of it, and the people offering work aren’t big on details.

 At 21:00 , you’ve still got a show.
 Get your equipment together and play rhythm-based concerts. Choose what comes next, control the flow of the set, and decide when to call it a night.
 A good gig builds your reputation. A bad one gives the guys something to argue about on the way home.

 The amp’s fucked. Another one costs money. Time to find some work.
 Collect cans. Take odd jobs. Try your luck at blackjack. You could spend the afternoon earning what you need, or convince yourself you’re one good hand away.
 Someone always knows a quicker way to make money.

 Meet the locals and take on jobs that get harder to explain the further you get into them. Sneak past cameras, get your hands dirty, and try to leave before anyone starts asking questions.
 You probably should’ve asked a few yourself.

 Have a drink. Get into an argument. Find out how many other people want to be involved.
 Fight, block, and use whatever’s lying around. Between underground fights, gangsters, and the police, there are plenty of ways to lose the rest of your afternoon.
 You need those hands for the concert.

 Explore Ashport, a neighbourhood of bars, back rooms, garages, and people with something for you to do. Follow main quests, pick up...

Tún is a relaxing gardening game with a touch of puzzle and strategy . The needs of your plants, the layout of your garden, and daily events gently influence what you grow and when. This adds an element of planning, without ever becoming too stressful.

 Expand your garden, decorate it to your own taste, and turn it into a delightful space

store.name: Shark Mart
store.short: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...
store.about:
SHARKS UNDERCOVER 

 You and your friends are sharks masquerading as dolphins to dupe and snatch the clueless fish who wander into your shop. Keep up the act and don't let those teeth show!
 MANAGE YOUR SHOP 

 Stock the shelves with sponges and bottled water, serve the locals, and keep the place spotless. Work your fins off to earn their trust - it’s the perfect cover for your shady business on the ocean floor!
 GIVE WHALES A GLOW-UP 

 Win the trust of the ocean’s behemoths by buffing their bellies and fins until they sparkle. Gaining whale loyalty is your ticket to winning over the smaller fry!
 THE PREDATOR'S SECRET KITCHEN 

 Snatch your own customers and turn them into gourmet delicacies in the hidden basement beneath your shop. Your shop is the bait, and they’re the main course!
 THE FISH POLICE ARE WATCHING 

 Underwater cops are on your tail! Scrub the crime scene, lie through your teeth during interrogations, and don’t let the fuzz catch a whiff of what’s cooking in your kitchen.

store.name: Qwak Reborn

store.about:
Cute looks. Brutal gameplay.
 Qwak Reborn is a frantic, single-screen arcade platformer where danger lurks around every corner. With an "out of the frying pan, into the fire" vibe that keeps you on your toes, this is pure chaos that’s simple to learn but impossible to put down.

 Originally born in the golden age of 80s arcade gaming, Qwak has been captivating players for decades. It has been lovingly rebuilt for modern platforms by the original solo creator. Same retro magic. Now on Steam.

 Go it alone or team up with a friend for chaotic 2 player fun across 70 levels and 7 distinct worlds!
 Key Features & How to Play: 
 The Main Goal: Race against the clock to collect all the golden keys and reach the exit before it starts raining deadly spikes!

 Eggs: Throw eggs at baddies, but manage your ammo wisely. Collect fruit to restock your egg supply, and hunt for special eggs that deal massive damage or rain down chocolate fruit or candy.

 Flowers and Skulls: Mushrooms swap flowers into skulls, and skulls into flowers. Collect 10 flowers for an extra life, but avoid the skulls at all costs!

 Puzzles: Use coloured keys to open gates and treasure chests. On puzzle levels, you'll need to pull levers, spring traps, and find vanishing walls in the perfect order to access goodies or find a diamond or two.

 Potions: Transform your abilities: zap baddies, double damage eggs, invisibility, high jump, freeze baddies, flying boots, invulnerability, extra armour, and more.

 Umbrellas: Grab umbrellas to make it rain! Coloured and white umbrellas drop fruits, potions, and supa eggs....

 yeah! Mechcha "Matching"

Start with almost nothing and build a thriving gold mining business from the ground up. Lease mining claims, operate heavy machinery, process tons of paydirt, and grow your operation into a mining empire.
 Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the most complete version of the game, bringing together every released expansion alongside new features, gameplay improvements, refreshed look, and quality of life upgrades.

 Expand your mining operation with two brand new vehicles. The Fuel Truck keeps your machines supplied wherever you work, while the Large Dump Truck lets you transport even greater amounts of material, helping you scale your operation faster than ever.

 Looking for a different kind of challenge? A new customizable game mode lets you tailor the economy, progression, and gameplay rules to create your perfect mining experience.

 IT'S FINALS WEEK! 
 Survive a series of increasingly difficult exams while eluding a strict teacher patrolling the classroom.
 To succeed, you'll have to work together with your friends: you pass together or fail together.

 STEAL ANSWERS AND SHARE THEM WITH THE SQUAD 
 There are other students who actually studied. Peek at their answers or knock them out if they don't feel like sharing.
 Find textbooks and pass them around. Use walkie-talkies, cellphones, binoculars, and other tools to find and share answers with your buddies.

 DON'T. GET. CAUGHT. 
 Cheat around and find out. Various restraints await misbehaving students. Yes, even a Cone of Shame.
 And watch out for the teacher - he throws erasers with suspiciously deadly accuracy.

 DRAW ON EVERYTHING! 
 Write down answers and pass them around on sheets of paper. Or just write them on the wall... or your friends' faces.
 The world is your canvas!

 HANG OUT IN THE HALL 
 Between exams, the hall is your hangout spot.
 Play basketball, throw baseballs, decorate statues, and devise your next cheating strategy.

 TOO COOL FOR SCHOOL 
 Cheating is temporary. Drip is forever.
 Pass exams to unlock new outfits and accessories for your character. Make sure everyone knows who carried the group.

Swords of Legends is a single-player action-adventure RPG set in the primordial age, a world drawn from the strange tales of classical Chinese literature, where mortals, gods, and wandering souls walk the same earth. 
 From Aurogon Shanghai, this is the official sequel to the Gujian series, carrying its signature storytelling and artistry to a new adventure.

 As an Arbiter of the Underworld, you can unleash mystical techniques, summon spirit creatures, and wield an arsenal of weapons — each with its own playstyle, from the swords of the living to the artifacts of the dead.
 Read your enemies' weakness, weave your powers, and bring down all who cross your path.

 Step into a world born of ancient Chinese myth, where the gods, demons, and beasts of The Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing) walk the earth once more - rendered in cinematic detail on Unreal Engine 5.
 Lotus ponds at first light, weathered temples drifting with leaves, lonely inns glowing in the mountains. Flower-spirits, headless ghosts, beauties with painted skin — alive down to the last brushstroke, all bound into a tale that spans the mortal realm and the underworld.

 Not every soul wants to leave. Some still cling to a final wish. Defeat them. Hear them out. Lay their burdens to rest — and the spirit you once fought will walk beside you, bringing a story, a power, and a voice all their own.
 Their tales are mirrors. The longer you walk together, the more of their past comes to light. Each one is a question for your own road: what kind of life do you want to live?

 Amazing Wildlife: Care for lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, leopards, gorillas, chimpanzees, crocodiles, hippos, and rhinos!

store.name: OKUREK
store.short: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the acidic mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.
store.about:
You couldn't save them. So you try to preserve them. 

 Someone deer to you had to leave in a hurry. There was a note on the kitchen table: take care of the cucumbers, you know how important they are to me. Water my flowers when you have time. I want to smell them when I get back.

 Arriving on a sunny day. You plant. You water. You pickle. You keep busy.
 The farm needs tending. There is always something that needs tending.

 Tend the Farm
 Work a real daily farming routine: plow plots, plant seeds, water, harvest cucumbers, collect eggs, seal pickling jars. The work is repetitive on purpose.

 Talk to the Pickles
 The jars on your shelf are not quiet. Unable to move, the pickles have had a lot of time to think about what you do when everything around you is being destroyed and if there really is nothing you can do about it.

 Explore a Land Already Dying
 An isolated homestead at the foot of Bohemia's sandstone cliffs but the cliffs have company. Mining towers squat on the ridge. A lake sits in the valley where ground used to be, eaten out from underneath by decades of excavation. The creek runs the color of rust. The trees at the forest's edge are already already bare, stripped long before autumn by smoke that settled in like a second sky.

 This is the 1980s Black Triangle. The land was sick before you got here. The purple rot spreading through your plots is just the latest thing wrong with this place. The mountains are still beautiful. You remember when the air was clean.

 Choose How You Grieve
 Suddenly the routine is gone. The farm is gone. Find what started this....

 Uncover A Huge World : Explore a huge world of 10 million mineable pixels. (For reference, the world is 1000x bigger than the what you see in the GIF above)

 Balls Go Brrrr! : The game physics supports thousands of balls, simultaneously bouncing around and breaking pixels, at a stable 60+ FPS frame rate.

A MOTEL, AN ARCADE AND A LONG NIGHT AHEAD
 Create your character, take over a roadside motel with a neon arcade next door and turn it into the stop everyone remembers. Rent out rooms, fill the hall with cabinets, feed the players, hire a crew and grow your business night after night, alone or with friends.

Become a Vaelwarden, a guardian of the land of Orr, protector of the people and spirits that call Orr home. Discover untold stories and forge lasting bonds with your fellow players as you glide, leap, sprint, and ride your way across a frontier with adventure around every corner.

 Master a combat system where depth is achieved through strategic skill use, positioning, and movement – where action RPG combat meets Guild Wars build-making – creating a unique combat experience.

 Run, slide, leap, and bound across Orr with a one-of-a-kind movement system that transfers your momentum between modes of travel, providing a free-form joy of movement through a world alive with adventure.

store.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
store.short: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.
store.about:
The story is set in a fantasy world floating in the sky. 
 Tio sets out on an adventure with her companions. In their journey to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn and reach the land of the angels, Tio forms a deep bond with Rikill. Along the way, she builds warm connections with the townspeople while becoming involved in the fate of the dying city.
 This is an emotionally rich tale centered around the characters’ growth, their bonds, and their adventure.

 Exploration and puzzle-solving are at the core of the gameplay. Players advance the adventure by solving various mechanisms and riddles.

 Two difficulty levels are available for selection. A cheat mode is also available for players who want to focus on the story, eliminating the risk of getting stuck.

 Save and load anytime, allowing for a casual playstyle without time restrictions.

 The tutorial is well-designed, making it accessible for WWA beginners, while also offering high-score challenges for advanced players.

 ※WWA (World Wide Adventure) is a classic Japanese puzzle-RPG style where players explore grid-based dungeons, collect limited keys and items, manage resources carefully, and solve fixed-position enemy puzzles with no random battles — emphasizing planning, efficiency, and brain-teasing strategy over traditional combat.

 High-quality puzzles
 Sophisticated and satisfying WWA-style puzzles that deliver a strong sense of accomplishment.

 High-Quality Presentation
 Beautiful and voluminous CGs, along with dark music that matches the...

store.name: Lords of the Fallen II
store.short: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.
store.about:
A thousand years have passed since the Great Rupture. 

Realm by realm, nation after nation, the Umbral darkness has consumed all in her path. One Kingdom remains - a sacred land shrouded by an ancient force. For a time, mankind found sanctuary in this haven, but as light fades, darkness rises, and now, the Eternal Night draws near. 

A hero must rise, for a God to fall.

Journey across a vast, war-torn kingdom crumbling from within, as the realms of living and dead bleed into one. From moonlit citadels to time-ravaged temples, tread carefully, for each step forward may well be your last. 

Engage in intense, soulslike battles where every strike counts thanks to a fast, fluid and aggressive combat system. Whether steel or sorcery, melee or ranged, experiment with countless builds to overcome each unique enemy encounter before delivering an arena-drenching execution. 

Confront colossal abominations forged in a world without hope and void of mercy. Each distinct boss battle showdown will prove a gruelling test of skill, grit, and will. Though aid is at hand, should you seek it…

As bearer of the Umbral lamp, you have the ability to pass between the realms of the living and the dead, each with its own pathways, treasures, and of course, nightmarish creatures. But even greater, darker powers await you on this journey… 

Journey through Thorngar alone or alongside a fellow Lampbearer in seamless online co-op. Both players will save all mainline progression in shared campaign mode, or join a casual session to simply lend a fellow crusader a helping hand.

store.name: Carry On Together
store.short: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?
store.about:
Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players.
 Start a small delivery company with your friends, take on moving jobs and try to get every item to its destination in one piece. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?
 LIFT TOGETHER 
 Some items are too heavy to carry alone. Stretch out your arms, sync up with your teammates and lift together with physics-based controls. Couches, fridges, pianos and giant boxes all need teamwork. Watch out for tight corridors, slippery stairs and that one friend who lets go at the worst possible moment.

 DRIVE THE TRUCK 
 Load the delivery truck, pick a driver and hit the road. Enjoy the view on the way, but stay alert: one sharp turn and the whole cargo flies. The road might be the most dangerous part of the job. Do you trust your driver?

 EVERY LOCATION IS A NEW DISASTER 
 From suburban houses with wide gardens to multi-story office buildings, from narrow apartment hallways to mountain dirt roads, every location brings its own kind of chaos. Fit the sofa in the elevator, roll the rock off the road, squeeze the wardrobe through the garden gate.

 GROW YOUR COMPANY 
 Every successful delivery earns money, and every broken item costs you. Upgrade your company, take on bigger jobs and prove you're the best (or worst) movers in town.

store.name: Sardoinky
store.short: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.
store.about:
Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. You work for a company that opens cans of sardines. That's it... That's the whole job.
 Buy a can, SPAM THE BUTTON, peel it open and sell the nice fish inside. The cash buys more cans and upgrades. It's not really about the money, though. It's about the fish!!

 You never know what's in a can until the lid comes off. Usually it's a sardine. Sometimes it's a foiled, stickered rarity worth a hundred times what you paid. Sometimes there's nothing in it at all.

 As in any realistic gambling scenario, the odds are against you. Luckily, the company sells upgrades for that. Everything has a price. Even luck.

 Sardines are just the start. There are weird fish, rare fish and a few things that have no business being in a can. Catch them all and fill out your collection.

What are you waiting for? Your shift starts now!

store.name: STATE Z
store.short: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.
store.about:
State Z is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game where you'll have to survive threats from human NPCs, zombies, other players, and your own needs, all within a 64 km² map with 100% exploration. Build your own base, hunt, gather resources, cultivate a farm, maintain vehicles, and trade with communities for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.
 Key Features

 64 km² of map with no empty spaces — everything was created by hand, ensuring that no two maps are alike.

 Everything has consequences. A simple search for supplements can turn into a disaster if you aren't prepared. 

 Make sure to take shelter in a safe place before leaving the game, as you remain in the game world even after you have disconnected.

 Trade with NPCs — everything can be bought or sold, but everything has its price. Short on cash? No problem: take on quests from NPCs to earn some extra coin.

 Accessibility — it’s all in your hands. Your game, your rules. Decide how you want to play State Z; adjust the settings at any time and play your way.

 (default option: no hit points and no health bar) — with or without a health bar, with or without damage points... the choice is yours.

 Save your progress at any time. You can use as many save slots as you like—after all, who hasn't saved their game before exploring a difficult area?

 Every action counts. Increase your experience level and improve your character. Whether it’s a simple gathering task or a major expedition into a bandit camp, you will earn XP.

 Extreme weather...

store.name: Moose Builders
store.short: Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels to power them. Research new machines to automate everything in multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends to survive in the desert and turn it into a solar farm.
store.about:
Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels to power them. Research new machines to automate everything in multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends to survive in the desert and turn it into a solar farm.

 Dig and process
 Dig sand and stone and use crushers, filtering machines and furnaces to process it into iron, silicon, copper, aluminium and more. 
 Craft
 Craft new and better tools to dig faster. Craft new and more machines to craft new things.
 Merge
 Merge four of the same tool or machine into one upgraded version. Merging tools increases the tool digging area, merging machines make them faster.
 Survive
 Keep track of your nutrition and hydration level and watch out for the heat from the sun. Failing to do so can lead to an untimely death.
 Automate
 Craft pipes to transport items between machines and craft lava extractors to get resources automatically from the ground. Automate everything in a large factory.  
 Features
 Open-world: Large voxel based desert(64km2) to build your solar farm and factory in

 Online-coop: Play alone to manage everything yourself or invite your friends to help you build the largest factory

 Merge (almost) anything: Merge four of the same tool or machine to make a better one

 Research: Unlock new materials, machines and tools through research

 Voxel-based world: Shape the world as you want by digging and placing blocks. 

 Vertical factories: Use machines and pipes to automate the crafting of anything and expand it in three dimensions

store.name: YuanRong
store.short: "Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing 2D turn-based tactical RPG. Four cultural origins, procedurally generated continents, individual soldier recruitment and training, chain-of-command formations, hex-grid combat, fight outnumbered.
store.about:
"Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing (Classic of Poetry)
 Yuanrong: Princeps Militum is a 2D turn-based tactical RPG. Choose a cultural origin, lead a company across a generated continent, visit settlements, take contracts, recruit and organize troops, and deploy on hex-grid battlefields.
 Mountains and rivers differ, recruitment stocks vary, battlefields hold unique conditions, and victories and defeats leave ripples. Your path, your soldiers, and your army are forged through every march and battle.

 Landscapes shaped by seeds 
 Every new game generates a continent from a seed. Coastlines, mountains, lakes, passes, regions, and settlements appear anew, altering marching routes with the terrain.
 Travel, scout, pursue enemies, and visit towns on the strategic map. Shortcuts may lead through dangerous terrain, while detours cost time and rations; survey the land before deciding your route.

 Diverse cultures, distinct doctrines 
 Central Plains, Steppe, West, and Desert cultures feature unique troops, formation templates, and tactics. Central Plains favor mutually supporting lines; Steppe relies on horse archery and swift charges; West uses shield lines and heavy armor to break enemy lines; Desert combines protective formations, ranged pressure, and fire attacks.
 Culture is not mere cosmetics. Recruits, available formations, enemy composition, and tactical tendencies all stem from their origin.

 Settlements have their purposes 
 Settlements are places to rest during travels. Enter towns to visit taverns, markets, recruitment offices, and notice boards to...

store.name: Goddle
store.short: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.
store.about:
Construct words from a grid of letters and score more points than friends and family! Grab your phone, find the words nobody else sees, and mix many languages and custom dictionaries all at once.
 Your phone is the controller

 The grid, scores, and timer live on the big screen. Everyone else plays on the phone already in their pocket: no extra controllers, no app store, no remote mouse, just a PC and some good old web browsers. Just type words from adjacent letters and hit send.

 Play with as many friends as you can gather.*

 *Only managed 9 friends and family so far. Apparently I'm not that popular. Be better than me. 
 Strategy?

 Do you prefer finding lots of small words? One massive word for a huge cashout? Sitting on your hands until the last ten seconds to drop a bomb? Snatching a plural from your friend's singular the moment they submit it?
 Play how you like... and argue about it afterwards!
 Six game modes, and counting

 Some reward speed. Some reward patience. Some reward hunting the letters everyone else is ignoring.

 Classic  - Find words with letters. That's it. That's the mode.

 Replace Letters  - Used letters get swapped out, so the grid never stops moving.

 Shared Words  - Words can be reused by different players. Great for playing with kids.

 Rising Letters  - Unused letters grow in value over time. Ignore that Q at your peril.

 Battle of Territory  - Claim letters by using them and score every second for the ground you hold.

 Hot Tile  - One glowing tile multiplies your score. Work it into a word before it moves.

 Any language. Any dictionary....

store.name: ANANTA
store.short: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.
store.about:
Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG with no rules. Step into the shoes of a diverse cast of characters and forge connections as you build a team all your own.
Join forces against the threats lurking in the shadows, or live it up and take in the nightlife under the neon glow. The choice is yours.

 Global release January 15th, 2027

In ANANTA, a whole new world awaits you. Ready to take the plunge?
 Become an Influencer and Save the World 
 You're a stranger in a strange land, but that's alright.
 The moment you set foot in Nova City,
 you start making a name for yourself.
 It's time to build your reputation, and save the world while you're at it.

 Two Cities, Two Adventures 
 Don't forget to head back home once in a while.
 One plane ticket and you're back to your old stomping grounds of Chongxiao.
 But even a place you know like the back of your hand
 is bound to have a hidden secret or two.

 Exhilarating Martial Arts Battles 
 From the second you raise your fist,
 the street becomes your stage,
 and each strike deserves to go viral.

 Experience the Thrill of 24/7 City Life 
 Boredom? Never heard of it.
 Drama that would make soap operas blush one day, 3AM street racing the next.
 No two days are the same.
 Every hour has something new on offer, and it can all be streamed anytime.

 Discover Different Walks of Life 
 NCCA officer, genius hacker, or gang leader?
 Inhabit all manner of different characters.
 Experience this world from top to bottom and everywhere in-between.
 Who knows, you may befriend some oddballs along the way.

 Unlimited Exploration
